title: A Low-Dimensional Chemical Representation of High-Resolution Stellar Disk Spectra: Residual Abundance Signatures
background_knowledge: 恒星光谱是恒星大气状态与化学组成的投影：有效温度 $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$、表面重力 $\log g$、整体金属丰度 $[\mathrm{M}/\mathrm{H}]$、微观湍流 $v_{\mathrm{mic}}$ 与自转 $v\sin i$ 等决定连续谱、线强和线形；各元素丰度 $[\mathrm{X}/\mathrm{H}]$ 则通过吸收线的深度与轮廓留下印记。不同元素由不同核合成过程产生，例如 $\alpha$ 元素（如 Ti）主要来自核心坍缩超新星，$s$ 过程元素（如 Y）与慢中子俘获过程关系密切，Nd 等元素则对不同中子俘获富集渠道敏感，因此丰度比值是追溯恒星形成历史和化学富集的关键。传统上通过逐条谱线拟合或合成光谱获得恒星参数与丰度；数据驱动方法则以大样本高分辨率光谱为训练集，将光谱表示为少量标签的低维函数，并用流量残差检验遗漏信息。银河系盘星中的低 $\alpha$ 群体通常对应较为年轻的薄盘或较近期的富集历史，其光谱中主导变化可由少数参数描述，但弱谱线与稀有元素信号可能隐藏在残差中。该范式连接了恒星光谱建模、化学丰度测量与大规模巡天化学标记，是理解银河系盘化学演化的重要基础。
contribution: 论文利用 HARPS 高分辨率、高信噪比光谱（$R=115{,}000$、$\mathrm{SNR}>100$）以及由 Korg 导出的标签，训练以 $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$、$\log g$、$[\mathrm{M}/\mathrm{H}]$、$v\sin i$、$v_{\mathrm{mic}}$ 和 $[\mathrm{Ti}/\mathrm{H}]$、$[\mathrm{Y}/\mathrm{H}]$、$[\mathrm{Nd}/\mathrm{H}]$ 为条件的 The Cannon 生成模型，并在未见测试星上通过流量残差检验低维表示对光谱的重建能力。结果显示，模型可将整体光谱重建到中位残差幅度 **0.3%**；对未标注元素而言，15 个吸收特征的残差通常 **小于 0.7%**；约 **1%** 的流量残差对应 **0.01–0.05 dex** 的丰度差异。将光谱降至中分辨率（$R=28{,}000$）时，中位残差幅度从 **0.3% 降至 0.2%**，但残差信号被重新分配到仪器线型之中。该公开模型在 $-1.13<[\mathrm{M}/\mathrm{H}]<0.29$ 范围内以 **亚百分之一精度** 再现 **29 种元素** 的特征。论文据此表明，**低 $\alpha$ 盘星光谱中主导的化学变化可由低维模型捕捉，而较弱的化学信息仍保留在流量残差中**；要分辨这一低维结构之外的层级化化学信息，需要 $R\sim100{,}000$、$\mathrm{SNR}>100$ 的高分辨率、高信噪比光谱。该工作为 4MOST、GALAH 2 以及 VLT/HRMOS、GMT/G-CLEF 等设施可获取的化学信息提供了基准。
summary: Stellar abundances are generated by complex chemical enrichment pathways yet show strong correlation structure. We test how well high-quality spectra of low-alpha disk stars can be reconstructed using low-dimensional models. By validating model performance in flux space, we quantify and locate where residual information persists. Using HARPS spectra (R = 115,000, SNR > 100) and labels derived with Korg, we train generative models (The Cannon) conditioned on stellar parameters Teff, log(g), [M/H], vsini, and vmic, and three abundance labels, [Ti/H], [Y/H], and [Nd/H], representing distinct nucleosynthetic families. Evaluating model performance on unseen test stars through flux residuals, the model reproduces the global spectra to a median residual amplitude of 0.3%. Deviations in 15 absorption features for unlabelled elements are typically < 0.7%. Residuals of ~1% correspond to abundance differences of 0.01-0.05 dex. Degrading the spectra to medium resolution (R = 28,000) decreases the median residual amplitude from 0.3% to 0.2%, redistributing the residual signal over the instrumental line profile. Our publicly available model reproduces features from 29 elements to sub-percent precision across -1.13 < [M/H] < 0.29. This demonstrates that the dominant chemical variation encoded in low-alpha disk spectra can be captured by a low-dimensional model, while weaker chemical information remains encoded in flux residuals. High-resolution, high-SNR spectra (R ~ 100,000, SNR > 100) are essential to resolve the hierarchical layers of chemical information beyond this low-dimensional structure. The model provides a benchmark for assessing the chemical information accessible to current surveys like 4MOST and GALAH 2, as well as upcoming facilities like VLT/HRMOS and GMT/G-CLEF.

title: GRAVITY-RESOLVE: A comprehensive image reconstruction tool for Galactic Center observations with GRAVITY
background_knowledge:
银河系中心距太阳约 $8\ \mathrm{kpc}$，包含一个致密核星团和超大质量黑洞人马座 A*（Sgr A*）。在近红外波段，尽管星际尘埃消光严重，借助自适应光学与长基线干涉测量仍可解析中心数角秒内的高速恒星（S 星）及暗弱星族。欧洲南方天文台（ESO）的 VLTI 上的 GRAVITY 将四台 $8.2\ \mathrm{m}$ 级望远镜的光进行相干合成，提供微角秒级天体测量与干涉可见度；其成像本质上是受稀疏 $uv$ 覆盖、有限动态范围、强源混淆及大气/仪器相位误差限制的病态反演问题。
\n干涉图像重建通常利用可见度振幅与闭合相位（对大气相位不敏感），并引入正则化先验，从稀疏采样中恢复天区亮度分布；对银心而言，亮星旁暗星的探测还受旁瓣、噪声和背景梯度影响。GRAVITY+ 的 GRAVITY-faint 模式旨在提高灵敏度，使更多暗星可见，但也对重建软件的限深、速度和多指向拼接能力提出更高要求。
contribution: 论文修订并发展了专门用于银心恒星成像的 GRAVITY-RESOLVE 代码（记为 $\mathrm{G}^{\mathrm{R}}$），核心目标是提高 GRAVITY 图像的极限星等、显著降低计算耗时，并支持对天区上多个空间分离数据集/指向的联合重建。作者将 $\mathrm{G}^{\mathrm{R}}$ 应用于包含 GRAVITY+ 升级中 GRAVITY-faint 模式的最新数据，重建可见度相位与振幅，并给出由这些量获得的首幅 $\mathrm{G}^{\mathrm{R}}$ GRAVITY 图像。通过联合重建 2025 年获取的九个独立数据集，作者演示了近红外拼接成像，在约 $3390\ \mathrm{AU}\times3390\ \mathrm{AU}$（即 $409.6\ \mathrm{mas}\times409.6\ \mathrm{mas}$）尺度上形成单幅图像。基于向 GRAVITY 数据注入点源的专门测试，在利用闭合相位与可见度振幅重建时，场中心半径 $25\ \mathrm{mas}$ 内的极限星等估计为 $m_{\mathrm{K}}\simeq20.0$。论文还报告在银心**发现两颗新暗星 S303 与 S304**，并发现**计算运行时间至少缩短约 $10$ 倍**。这些结果表明 $\mathrm{G}^{\mathrm{R}}$ 是快速、精确且具有深探测能力的银心图像重建工具，**为发现更多暗星铺平道路**。
summary: We aim to improve and extend the imaging capabilities of the GRAVITY beam combiner instrument of ESOs VLTI with respect to reconstruction software in the Galactic Center. We revise and develop the image reconstruction code GRAVITY-RESOLVE $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$, which has been specifically developed to reconstruct stars in the Galactic Center with GRAVITY. The main objectives are to increase the limiting magnitude in GRAVITY images, reduce its computational runtime, and allow for a joint reconstruction of multiple, spatially separate datasets/pointings on sky. We apply $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$ to recent GRAVITY data, featuring the implemented GRAVITY-faint mode as part of GRAVITY+, the upgrade of GRAVITY. We reconstruct visibility phases and amplitudes and present the first GRAVITY image reconstructed with $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$ from these quantities. We demonstrate NIR mosaicking with $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$ by jointly reconstructing nine separately acquired datasets of 2025 into a single image on a scale of $\simeq 3390\ \text{AU}\times 3390\ \text{AU}$, corresponding to $409.6\ \text{mas}\times 409.6\ \text{mas}$. With dedicated injection tests of point sources into GRAVITY data, we estimate the limiting magnitude to be $m_{\text{K}}\ \simeq\ 20.0$ within a radius of $25\ \text{mas}$ around the field center when reconstructing from closure phases and visibility amplitudes. We report on the discovery of two new faint stars in the Galactic Center: S303 and S304. Finally, we find a decrease in computational runtime by a factor of at least $\sim10$. With $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$, we demonstrate GRAVITYs capabilities for NIR imaging. We show that $\text{G}^{\text{R}}$ is a fast, precise, and deep image reconstruction tool for Galactic Center observations, enabling the discovery of even more faint stars.

title: Inelastic Kinetic Decoupling in WIMP Leptogenesis: A Minimal $Z_4$ Model
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学表明，暗物质约占宇宙能量密度的 26%，但其粒子性质仍未知。热遗迹 WIMP 图像假定暗物质在早期宇宙处于热平衡，通过湮灭退耦留下今天丰度。完整描述除化学脱耦外还需追踪动能脱耦：当暗物质与等离子体之间的动量交换率降到 Hubble 膨胀率以下，暗物质温度 $ T_{\chi} $ 不再跟随辐射温度，从而影响遗迹丰度、结构形成和粒子产生过程。重子不对称的起源需要满足 Sakharov 条件；leptogenesis 先在轻子部门产生 $ B-L $ 不对称，再由弱电 sphaleron 过程部分转化为重子不对称。WIMP leptogenesis 将暗物质湮灭、CP 破坏与轻子不对称产生联系起来，是粒子宇宙学中连接暗物质、中微子质量与重子生成的重要范式；共振、质量差、非弹性散射和动能脱耦都会改变其定量预言。
contribution: 论文构建了一个最小 $ Z_4 $ 对称的标准模型扩展：单态 Dirac 费米子 $ \chi $ 作为暗物质，其湮灭通过 WIMP leptogenesis 产生轻子不对称；动能平衡主要由非弹性转换 $ \chi L \leftrightarrow \bar{\chi}\Psi $ 维持。作者从完整非弹性碰撞算子出发，推导了用于动能脱耦的有效动量转移率，并联立求解暗物质丰度、暗物质温度 $ T_{\chi} $ 与 $ B-L $ 不对称的 Boltzmann 方程。研究发现，较大的质量差会使转换率随宇宙冷却而更快下降，从而**自然地使动能脱耦发生在更早时期，且不要求处于共振**；**早期动能脱耦可显著改变暗物质遗迹丰度**，不过在共振附近，湮灭致热可削弱这一改变。若不对称产生与显著的动能非平衡重叠，$ B-L $ 不对称会受到影响；扫描中最大偏离主要出现在 $ x_{\rm lep} \gtrsim x_{\rm cd} $。在施加约束后，不对称产生通常结束于化学脱耦之前，**最终不对称基本保持不变**。间接探测方面，作者用 Pythia 生成光子谱，并采用 Fermi-LAT 矮椭球星系数据给出的似然进行评估。
summary: We study a minimal $Z_4$-symmetric extension of the Standard Model in which a singlet Dirac fermion $χ$ constitutes dark matter, whose annihilations generate a lepton asymmetry through WIMP leptogenesis. Kinetic equilibrium is maintained mainly by the inelastic conversion $χL\leftrightarrow\barχΨ$. Compared with the near elastic regime, a sizable mass gap suppresses the conversion rate more rapidly as the Universe cools. This naturally drives kinetic decoupling to earlier times, even away from resonance. Starting from the full inelastic collision operator, we derive an effective momentum transfer rate for kinetic decoupling. We then solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the dark matter abundance, its temperature $T_χ$, and the $B-L$ asymmetry. Early kinetic decoupling can significantly modify the relic abundance, although near resonance this modification can be reduced by annihilation-induced heating. The $B-L$ asymmetry can be affected when asymmetry production overlaps with a substantial departure from kinetic equilibrium. In our scan, the largest deviations occur mainly for $x_{\rm lep}\gtrsim x_{\rm cd}$. After imposing our constraints, asymmetry production typically ends before chemical decoupling, leaving the final asymmetry essentially unchanged. For indirect detection, we generate the photon spectrum with Pythia and evaluate the Fermi-LAT dwarf spheroidal likelihood.

title: Nongravitational Motion of 3I/ATLAS Far from the Sun: Robust Detection, Weak Constraints on the Activity Law
background_knowledge: 太阳系小天体的轨道主要由引力决定，但彗星等天体在接近太阳时发生挥发性物质升华，产生非引力（NG）加速度，从而在天体测量中留下可检测的轨道偏离。标准非引力轨道模型通常把加速度写成活动函数 $g(r)$ 与若干方向分量的乘积，其中 $r$ 为日心距；$g(r)$ 常取水冰升华律或更易挥发冰的幂律形式。由于 $g(r)$ 与轨道参数、观测弧长和残差系统误差存在简并，利用天体测量数据同时检测非引力信号并反演其日心依赖十分困难。星际天体提供了不同于太阳系彗星的独立样本，其远离太阳时的微弱非引力效应尤为适合检验活动律的可辨识性，但也对轨道拟合和残差分析提出更高要求。
contribution: 论文分析 3I/ATLAS 在近日点前日心距大于 3.49 au、近日点后大于 2.67 au 的天体测量数据，分别拟合纯引力轨道与采用多种活动律的非引力轨道，包括标准水冰升华律以及更平坦、更易挥发冰的方案，并用正态性检验和观测减计算（O-C）残差的时间趋势评估拟合质量。结果显示，近日点前的远距离观测可由纯引力轨道很好描述，而近日点后的远距离数据在纯引力模型下呈现统计显著的非高斯残差；将前后两段远距离观测联合后，非引力加速度变得清晰可检测，表现为残差 RMS 显著下降和系统性残差趋势消失。**然而，现有天体测量数据不能唯一区分所测试的活动律**：标准水冰、更易挥发和极端挥发方案尽管日心依赖明显不同，却给出统计上相当的轨道拟合。因此，**非引力加速度的存在性比其物理起源或日心依赖受到的天体测量约束强得多**。
summary: 3I/ATLAS provides an unprecedented astrometric data set for studying nongravitational (NG) effects in an interstellar object, but existing orbital solutions depend strongly on assumptions regarding the heliocentric activity law and the treatment of the astrometric data. We investigate the extent to which astrometric observations constrain the heliocentric dependence of the NG activity function, focusing on the identifiability of different functional forms of $g(r)$ within standard NG orbit-determination frameworks. Astrometric observations obtained at heliocentric distances larger than 3.49 au before perihelion and 2.67 au after perihelion were analysed. Purely gravitational and nongravitational orbital solutions were determined using several activity laws, including the standard water-ice sublimation law and flatter more volatile ice prescriptions. The resulting residual distributions were evaluated using normality tests and analyses of temporal trends in the observed-minus-calculated residuals. The distant pre-perihelion observations are well described by a purely gravitational (GR) orbit, whereas the distant post-perihelion data exhibit a statistically significant non-Gaussian residual distribution under the GR model. When the distant pre- and post-perihelion observations are combined, nongravitational acceleration becomes clearly detectable through a significant reduction in the residual rms and the disappearance of systematic residual trends. However, the astrometric data do not uniquely distinguish between the tested activity laws: standard water-ice, more volatile and extreme volatile prescriptions produce statistically comparable orbital fits despite their markedly different heliocentric dependences. The existence of nongravitational acceleration is therefore considerably better constrained by astrometry than its physical origin or heliocentric dependence.

title: Gravitational Dark Matter Production from Spectator Field in $R^2$-Higgs Inflation
background_knowledge: 标准宇宙学中，暴胀阶段的快速膨胀会把量子涨落拉伸到超视界尺度，并通过时变背景时空导致粒子产生；若产生的粒子足够稳定且与标准模型相互作用极弱，就可能构成暗物质。所谓引力暗物质产生，指暗物质只通过引力或非最小引力耦合与时空背景联系，而非依赖常规粒子相互作用。非最小耦合 $\xi_\chi \chi^2 R$ 会使标量场的有效质量随 Ricci 标量 $R$ 变化，从而显著影响产生效率和遗迹丰度。$R^2$-Higgs 暴胀是 Starobinsky 型 $R^2$ 暴胀与 Higgs 暴胀结合的多场模型；研究此类模型中的粒子产生通常需从 Jordan 框架共形变换到 Einstein 框架，并小心处理多场运动方程、扰动和预加热阶段。预加热期间 Higgs 与 Goldstone 场的非微扰动力学可产生强时空变化，从而成为暗物质产生的重要来源。
contribution: 论文研究多场 $R^2$-Higgs 暴胀中标量旁观场 $\chi$ 的宇宙学引力暗物质产生。$\chi$ 仅通过非最小耦合 $\xi_\chi \chi^2 R$ 与引力作用，并作为暗物质候选者。作者在 Einstein 框架下采用双重协变形式，推导背景场及线性阶扰动的运动方程。结果表明，$\chi$ 的暗物质产生及随后的共动遗迹丰度强烈依赖于该场的有效质量；**有效质量平方中存在抵消区域，可使正确的遗迹丰度得以实现**。此外，**来自 Higgs 和 Goldstone 的预加热可能在解释观测遗迹密度方面起关键作用**。
summary: We investigate the cosmological gravitational dark matter production of spectator field $χ$ in the multifield $R^2$-Higgs inflation. The spectator field $χ$ couples to gravity only through a non-minimal coupling $ξ_χχ^2R$ and serves as a dark matter (DM) candidate. Working consistently in the Einstein frame, we derive the equation of motion of the background fields and fluctuations at linear order using the doubly covariant formalism. We show the dark matter production and the subsequent comoving relic abundance heavily depend on this effective mass of the field $χ$. Specifically, we find that there exists cancellation regions in the effective mass-squared of $χ$, which ensures the correct relic abundance is achieved. Further, we show that the preheating from Higgs and Goldstone may play critical role in accounting the observed relic density.

title: Characterisation of the ILMT 4K x 4K TDI CCD imager
background_knowledge: 天文 CCD 成像是把入射光子转换为电子、再经模数转换以 ADU 记录的过程。增益描述每个 ADU 对应的电子数（单位 $e^{-}/\mathrm{ADU}$），读出噪声（RON）则反映读出电子学引入的随机波动；二者是曝光时间换算、信噪比估计和图像定标的基础参数。常用标定手段包括偏置帧、平场帧以及光子转移曲线，即利用信号方差与平均信号之间的线性关系求增益。对于天顶指向的液态镜望远镜 ILMT，望远镜不能任意指向，天体因地球自转而掠过焦面，因此 CCD 需工作在 TDI 模式，让电荷转移速度与天体周日运动同步，以实现有效积分。TDI 观测与非均匀照明条件下的 CCD 参数表征，对保证测光定标和图像质量十分重要。
contribution: 本文针对 ILMT 的 $4\mathrm{K}\times4\mathrm{K}$ CCD 成像器，在 TDI 工作模式下测定增益与读出噪声。作者利用晨光渐亮期间拍摄的、具有非均匀照明的 CCD 帧，采用两种方法：一是沿水平梯度最小的方向逐行统计流量方差，以尽量规避强垂直照明梯度；二是把帧划分为背景照明相近的区域，分析两区域间的流量比变化。文中建立信号方差与平均流量之间的线性关系以确定增益，并由偏置帧独立测量读出噪声。两种方法均给出约 $3.9\,e^{-}/\mathrm{ADU}$ 的增益，偏置帧给出的读出噪声为 $1.55\,\mathrm{ADU}$（约 $6\,e^{-}$）。**这些结果为理解该 CCD 的性能并实现精确标定提供了依据。**
summary: In this work, we determine the gain and read-out noise of the 4Kx4K CCD imager used with the 4-m International Liquid Mirror Telescope (ILMT). Due to the zenith-pointing characteristic of the telescope, the CCD operates in the Time Delay Integration (TDI) mode for image acquisition. The CCD frames obtained during rising twilight have non-uniform illumination and can potentially be used to calculate important CCD parameters using two approaches. The first approach directly measures variance in flux along rows with minimum horizontal gradient, despite the strong vertical illumination gradient. The second method divides the CCD frame into regions exposed to similar background illumination and analyses the flux ratio variation between the two regions. Mathematically, we establish a linear relationship between the signal variance and average flux, from which gain is determined, while the read-out noise (RON) is measured independently from the bias frames. Both methods provide a gain value of approximately 3.9 e/ADU, while the RON measured from bias frames is 1.55 ADU (~ 6 e). Estimation of these parameters provides a better understanding of the CCD performance and allows for an accurate calibration.

title: lenscape: Fast, High-resolution $Δχ^2$ Maps of Microlensing Events
background_knowledge: 引力微透镜效应是指前景天体（透镜）的引力场使背景恒星（源星）的光线发生偏折，从而在观测上表现为源星亮度随时间短暂增亮。当透镜系统包含行星时，行星会在主透镜光变曲线上产生持续时间较短的异常信号，这为探测冷行星、测量其质量比和轨道分离等参数提供了重要途径。行星微透镜建模通常需要在二元透镜分离 $s$ 与质量比 $q$ 构成的参数平面上反复优化完整光变曲线，并计算有限源尺度下的放大率。由于不同参数组合可能产生相似观测信号，模型中常出现简并解，因此需要构建 $\Delta\chi^2$ 图来定位这些简并解并限定参数不确定度。传统上，$\Delta\chi^2$ 图上每个网格点都对应一次独立的光变曲线优化，计算量很大，往往成为事件建模的主要瓶颈；局部极小值还可能造成虚假结构和伪解。
contribution: 作者发布了开源 Python 包 lenscape，用于快速生成高分辨率微透镜事件的 $\Delta\chi^2$ 图，并通过多阶段邻域传播与自适应等值线细化来抑制局部极小值造成的伪影。将该工具应用于行星微透镜事件 MOA-2022-BLG-091 时，lenscape **在 14 分钟内重现了已发表的 $50\times50$ 图**，并**在桌面计算机上于两小时内生成了 $400\times400$ 图**，显著提升了 $\Delta\chi^2$ 制图效率。
summary: Planetary microlensing analyses rely on $Δχ^2$ maps across the binary-lens separation $s$ and mass ratio $q$ to locate degenerate solutions and bound parameter uncertainties. Because every grid point requires a full light-curve optimization with finite-source magnifications, constructing these maps is often the primary computational bottleneck in event modeling. Here I present lenscape, an open-source Python package that accelerates $Δχ^2$ mapping and suppresses local-minimum artifacts through multi-stage neighbor propagation and adaptive contour refinement. Applied to the planetary event MOA-2022-BLG-091, lenscape reproduces the published $50\times50$ map in 14 minutes and generates a $400\times400$ map in under two hours on a desktop computer.

title: Toward a Complete Interpretation of Global 21 cm Absorption Signals Using the Radio CMB
background_knowledge: 宇宙学中的 21 cm 线来自中性氢基态超精细能级跃迁，静止频率约 1420 MHz。经宇宙膨胀红移后，它落在低频射电波段，可用于探测宇宙黑暗时代与宇宙黎明，并约束第一代恒星和 X 射线源如何形成、何时加热周围气体以及再电离历史。对天空平均的全局 21 cm 信号，其微分亮温在光学薄近似下与 $(T_{\rm S}-T_{\gamma})\tau_{21}$ 相关，其中 $T_{\rm S}$ 是中性氢自旋温度，$T_{\gamma}$ 是射电背景亮温，$\tau_{21}\propto n_{\rm HI}/T_{\rm S}$ 是 21 cm 光学深度。因此，单个全局吸收槽的幅度不能唯一确定 $T_{\rm S}$ 与 $T_{\gamma}$：冷气体模型与额外射电背景模型都可能解释类似 EDGES 的异常吸收。观测上还须克服银河系同步辐射等明亮前景、电离层效应和仪器系统误差。CMB 提供了另一条途径：高红移中性氢对穿过的 CMB 光子产生共振吸收，从而在射电波段 CMB 各向异性上留下额外的频率依赖光学深度；该光学深度只依赖自旋温度，因此可与全局信号联合，打破上述简并。
contribution: 论文提出把全局 21 cm 吸收测量与射电波段 CMB 各向异性中的高红移中性氢光学深度测量结合起来。Holder et al. 2026 表明，该 CMB 光学深度只依赖自旋温度，因而与全局信号联合可打破冷气体与超额射电背景之间的简并，并在不依赖天体物理建模的情况下分离出射电背景温度。作者对四种干涉阵列配置进行了预报：**一个由 $55 \times 55$ 个 6 m 天线组成的紧凑阵列观测 4000 小时，可在 $4.2\sigma$ 显著性上确认类似 EDGES 的光学深度；而对于基准宇宙黎明历史，所需集光面积约再增加一个量级**。这为解释任何全球 21 cm 探测提供了模型无关的途径。
summary: The global 21 cm signal is among the most direct probes of cosmic dawn, encoding information about when the first stars formed and how efficiently they heated their surroundings. However, such measurements are limited by bright Galactic foregrounds, ionospheric effects, and instrumental systematics. Even a confident detection would face a further obstacle: the brightness temperature depends on the spin temperature of the gas and the temperature of the radio background only through a single combination, so anomalous signals such as the EDGES (Bowman et al. 2018) absorption trough admit both cold gas and excess radio background interpretations. Recently, Holder et al. 2026 showed that resonant 21 cm absorption by high-redshift neutral hydrogen imprints an excess optical depth on CMB anisotropies at radio wavelengths, which depends on the spin temperature alone. Here we propose combining a measurement of the CMB hydrogen optical depth with the global signal to break this degeneracy, isolating the radio background temperature without the need for astrophysical modelling. Forecasting four interferometric configurations, we find that a compact $55 \times 55$ array of 6 m dishes observing for 4000 hours can establish an EDGES-like optical depth at $4.2σ$, while fiducial cosmic dawn histories require roughly an order of magnitude more collecting area. This constitutes a model-independent route to interpreting any global 21 cm detection.

title: posterior-landscape: morphological feature finding in two-dimensional probability densities
background_knowledge: 现代引力波观测已从单次事件探测进入族群统计阶段。其核心研究范式是分层贝叶斯推断：用一组超参数描述致密双星等源的族群分布，并将单次事件的后验样本按似然和探测选择效应加权，得到族群超参数的后验概率密度。二维后验密度常出现多峰、脊线、谷区、弯曲和斜率突变，这些形态可能对应物理子族群、参数简并、选择效应或推断噪声，因此需要可重复、可量化的形态学描述，而不能只依赖一维边缘分布。拓扑数据分析、密度脊估计与尺度空间图像分析可用于识别局部集中、脊、谷和斜率变化；将二维结构映射到一维边缘并与其他推断参数做相关性分析，有助于判断哪些族群特征稳健、哪些携带宇宙学信息。引力波标准汽笛等宇宙学应用依赖对族群参数及其红移演化的准确刻画，因此后验形态的客观描述是连接族群重建与宇宙学推断的重要环节。
contribution: 论文提出并实现了 posterior-landscape 这一 Python 框架，用于在二维概率密度中识别和刻画形态特征。该框架融合拓扑数据分析、统计密度脊估计和尺度空间图像分析，**系统提取局部集中、谷、脊以及斜率变化**；针对贝叶斯重建，它还传播特征恢复、几何形态和特征对应关系中的不确定性。框架进一步把二维结构与一维边缘分布中的特征联系起来，并量化这些结构与其他推断参数的相关性。作者在受控密度上验证了方法，并将其用于引力波族群重建，**提供了一种系统识别、解释族群特征并判断哪些特征携带宇宙学信息的途径**。其输出的特征目录还为未来理论预测与族群重建之间的比较提供了统一的形态学表示。
summary: We present posterior-landscape, a Python framework to identify and characterize morphological features in two-dimensional probability densities. The framework combines concepts from topological data analysis, statistical density-ridge estimation, and scale-space image analysis. It extracts localized concentrations, valleys, ridges, and changes of slope; for Bayesian reconstructions, it propagates uncertainty in feature recovery, geometry, and correspondence across posteriors. The framework also connects two-dimensional structures to features in one-dimensional marginals, and quantifies their correlation with other inferred parameters. We validate the method on controlled densities, and demonstrate its use on gravitational-wave population reconstructions, where it provides a systematic way to identify and interpret population features and assess which ones carry information relevant for cosmology. The resulting catalogues also offer a common morphological representation for future comparisons between predictions and population reconstructions.

title: Model-Based Retrieval of Four Years of JWST/NIRCam Wavefronts
background_knowledge:
该工作属于空间天文望远镜的光学测量与波前定标（wavefront sensing and calibration）方向，而非某一类天体物理对象研究。JWST 主镜由 18 块六边形铍镜段组成，口径约 6.5 m；为了在近红外波段接近衍射极限，各镜段的位置、倾斜与面形必须维持在极小误差范围内。温度变化、姿态扰动、镜段漂移以及仪器内部光学都会引入波前误差，使点扩散函数（PSF）变形，进而影响测光、天体测量、光谱与扩展源形态测量。因此，望远镜需要每隔数日对明亮参考星拍摄一对散焦图像，通过分析散焦星像中的强度分布反演光瞳处的相位误差，这一过程称为相位恢复（phase retrieval）。
\n相位恢复本质上是一个非线性逆问题：给定望远镜与相机的光学模型，将待求波前展开为若干光学模式或像素化相位，正向模拟光在光瞳、散焦与探测器上的传播，再与观测到的散焦图像比较并优化参数。传统的相位恢复流程通常依赖迭代优化与正则化，以抑制噪声、探测器效应与模型误差带来的病态性。NIRCam 作为 JWST 的主力近红外相机，其短波与长波通道均可用于波前传感；散焦量、滤光片、探测器响应与光学传播模型都会影响反演精度。
\n近年来，可微编程与物理正向建模成为该领域的重要范式：若整个光学传播与探测器模型可自动求导，就可以利用梯度优化高效拟合高维波前参数，并把历史波前传感数据作为先验或约束，提升单次测量的稳定性与精度。这类方法不仅服务于望远镜运行期的镜面共相与定标，也有望把波前信息直接传播到科学图像分析中，实现更精确的 PSF 建模与预测性校准。
contribution: 论文提出并公开了 camino（Computational Aberration Modelling and Inference for NIRCam Observations）：一个用 JAX 构建、基于可微 Fresnel 光学代码 dLUX 的开源 NIRCam 建模与推断算法，并采用以全部 NIRCam 波前传感数据档案为条件的正则化最大似然推断。相比既有流程，该方法通常将散焦图像拟合的约化 $\chi^2$ 从 60–65 降至 12–13，显著改善了模型与观测的一致性。作者据此重建了 JWST 从科学运行开始至 2026 年初的波前历史。**该开源实现可与 STScI 现行相位恢复算法并行运行，使更广泛的科学界能够获得高精度波前估计，并可直接嵌入科学分析工作流；这也是迈向基于物理正向建模的预测性定标、从而免除耗时专用参考星观测目标的重要一步。**
summary: The fidelity of data recovered by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) depends on precise monitoring of the mirror segments' surfaces and alignment. To this end, every few days the observatory takes pairs of defocused images of a reference star with its NIRCam instrument; a closed-source phase retrieval package is then employed to infer the wavefront. We here present camino (Computational Aberration Modelling and Inference for NIRCam Observations), an open-source algorithm to model NIRCam built in JAX using the differentiable Fresnel optics code dLUX and regularised maximum likelihood inference that has been conditioned on the entire archive of NIRCam wavefront sensing data. We typically improve the reduced chi-squared in fits to the defocused data from 60-65 to 12-13. We reconstruct the wavefront history of JWST from the beginning of science operations to early 2026. This open source implementation operates in parallel to the current STScI phase retrieval algorithm, allowing access by the broader scientific community to high-accuracy wavefront estimation and enabling its direct integration into science-analysis workflows. This represents a major step towards the ultimate goal of predictive calibration methods based on physics-based forward modelling, obviating the need for time-consuming observation of contemporaneous dedicated reference stars.

title: Temporal regularization of petal modes in SCAO systems: The Soft-Limiter approach
background_knowledge: 该工作属于极大望远镜（extremely large telescopes，ELTs）自适应光学与波前控制这一仪器/方法学方向。ELT 主镜由大量分段镜拼成，镜面间隙与厚重支撑结构使光瞳被切割；在单共轭自适应光学（single-conjugate AO，SCAO）中，各分段的波前误差可出现彼此独立的常数偏移，即差分活塞或 petal modes。这类模式在可见光下对金字塔波前传感器（Pyramid Wavefront Sensor，PWFS）响应很弱，残余湍流下尤其如此；若控制器不能约束它们，差分活塞会累积并跨越多个波长，造成“Island Effect”，使点扩散函数（PSF）和科学波段成像质量退化。常规做法包括空间缓解（如 Edge Actuator Coupling）或时间滤波/泄漏积分控制；核心权衡是既要稳定 petal 模式，又不能牺牲连续模式校正，并需与后续 phasing sensor 对整数波长模糊的解析相配合。
contribution: 论文提出 Minimum Mean Square Error（MMSE）Soft-Limiter：一种确定性、轻量级的控制器，把由 von Kármán 湍流先验导出的子空间 MMSE 估计器与连续时间正则化结合，仅对相对 petal 自由度施加泄漏积分作用。端到端 SPECULA 的 ELT/ANDES 仿真显示，**经典积分器在视宁度 $\ge 1.0''$ 时会失锁并在多个条纹间漂移，而 MMSE Soft-Limiter 在 $0.6-1.2''$ 范围内把差分活塞限制在单个条纹内**；在强湍流下限制 petal 偏移及其对科学波段的影响，在良好视宁度下仍保持最优连续模式校正，且**没有 Edge Actuator Coupling 等空间缓解带来的 Strehl 惩罚**。作者推导并验证泄漏增益的工作窗口 $g \lesssim g_{\mathrm{eff}}/\pi$：低于该上限时，快速环路可在小 droop 下保留至 $\lambda_{\mathrm{WFS}}/2$ 的真实物理台阶，从而在快速传感器上维持稳定的模 $\lambda_{\mathrm{WFS}}$ 波前，让较慢的 phasing sensor 解析整数模糊。随着湍流增强窗口收窄，其边界约在 $1.0''$ 视宁度附近相交；超过此范围，保留物理不连续性的任务将主要由 phasing 通道承担，这是分段 ELT 设计的关键驱动因素。
summary: Extremely large telescopes (ELTs) rely on segmented mirrors and thick support structures that fragment the pupil. In single-conjugate AO (SCAO), this produces differential pistons, or petal modes. The Pyramid Wavefront Sensor (PWFS), baseline for ANDES, MICADO, HARMONI, and GMT-NGSAO, has poor sensitivity to these modes in the visible under realistic residual turbulence. We aim to prevent the "Island Effect", where poorly observed differential pistons accumulate and degrade the PSF, without compromising continuous-mode correction. We propose the Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) Soft-Limiter, a deterministic, lightweight controller combining a subspace MMSE estimator derived from von Kármán priors with a continuous temporal regularization. It acts as a leaky integrator applied only to the relative petal degrees of freedom. End-to-end SPECULA simulations of ELT/ANDES show that, while a classical integrator loses lock and wanders across multiple fringes at seeing $\ge 1.0''$, the MMSE Soft-Limiter confines the differential piston within a single fringe over the $0.6-1.2''$ range. It bounds the petal excursion and its science-band impact under severe turbulence, while keeping optimal continuous-mode correction at good seeing, without the Strehl penalty of spatial mitigation such as Edge Actuator Coupling. We derive and verify the operating window for the leakage gain, $g \lesssim g_{\mathrm{eff}}/π$: below it, the fast loop retains genuine physical steps up to $λ_{WFS}/2$ with a small droop. This maintains a stable modulo-$λ_{WFS}$ wavefront on the fast sensor, letting a slower phasing sensor resolve integer ambiguities. As the window narrows with turbulence, its boundaries cross near $1.0''$ seeing; beyond this, retaining physical discontinuities becomes the sole responsibility of the phasing channel, a key design driver for segmented ELTs.

title: At the EDGES of MADness: phenomenology of relic millicharged atomic dark matter
background_knowledge:
现代宇宙学标准模型（ΛCDM）表明，宇宙能量预算中约四分之一为冷暗物质、约七成为暗能量；暗物质通过引力塑造星系、星系团和大尺度结构，并在宇宙微波背景（CMB）与星系巡天中留下关键印记。其微观本质仍是粒子物理与宇宙学交叉的核心问题：除弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）等主流候选外，隐藏扇区（hidden sector）模型日益受关注。此类模型可包含暗光子与带暗电荷的费米子；暗光子通过动力学混合（kinetic mixing）与普通光子耦合，使暗粒子获得微小有效电荷 $\varepsilon e$，从而成为毫电荷暗物质（millicharged dark matter）。即便 $\varepsilon$ 小至 $10^{-6}$ 至 $10^{-4}$，这类粒子仍可与重子气体散射，改变复合历史、气体热历史、恒星与超新星冷却，并影响 CMB、大尺度结构和实验室探测，因此其参数空间受到多手段联合限制。
\n原子暗物质（atomic dark matter）把标准氢原子的物理搬到隐藏扇区：暗质子与暗电子在暗电磁力下形成暗原子，并经历暗复合（dark recombination）。若暗扇区与可见扇区存在微小动力学混合，暗复合后残留的少量暗离子就带有毫电荷，形成天然低丰度的毫电荷组分。该图像为“暗物质主要中性、仅极小部分带电”的情形提供了粒子物理动机。与此同时，宇宙黎明（Cosmic Dawn）的 21-cm 吸收线是探测重子气体热状态与暗物质-重子相互作用的敏感探针；EDGES 实验曾报道异常强的吸收信号，激发了用毫电荷暗物质解释的讨论，但该解释需要毫电荷组分仅占暗物质总量的不到百分之一，且必须同时满足 CMB 等宇宙学限制。
contribution: 论文提出毫电荷原子暗物质（millicharged atomic dark matter，MAD）框架，说明极低丰度的毫电荷暗物质可由原子暗物质的暗复合残余自然产生：暗离子在动力学混合下获得微小电荷，而绝大多数暗物质仍以中性暗原子形式存在。作者修改宇宙学玻尔兹曼求解器 CLASS 以纳入该情景，并系统考察 MAD 参数空间中仍被 CMB、大尺度结构和超新星数据允许的区域。**核心结果是：MAD 存在宇宙学上可行、且与实验室和天体物理限制相容的参数区，并与 EDGES 所暗示的毫电荷窗口部分重叠。** 这为 EDGES 解释所需的极小毫电荷丰度提供了自然机制。虽然 EDGES 结果很可能并非宇宙黎明信号，**MAD 仍会留下可供未来 21-cm 观测检验的独特宇宙学特征。**
summary: Millicharged dark matter lives in a corner of parameter space that has been considerably shrinking over the past decades, due to constraints from cosmology, astrophysical systems, and ground-based experiments. A particularly interesting probe is the 21-cm absorption signal at Cosmic Dawn, which attracted interest in light of the EDGES claim: the reported excess absorption can be explained by millicharged dark matter with a fractional electric charge of~$10^{-6} \lesssim ε\lesssim 10^{-4}$, but it must be a subpercent of the total dark matter abundance to remain consistent with the cosmic microwave background (CMB). We show that very low fractions of millicharged dark matter naturally arise from atomic dark matter: a dark sector model that replicates the physics of standard atomic hydrogen. Dark ions undergo the process of dark recombination, leaving a relic ionized component that, in the presence of kinetic mixing, is naturally millicharged. We modify the cosmological Boltzmann solver CLASS to incorporate this scenario, and we investigate the parameter space of millicharged atomic dark matter (MAD) that is allowed by CMB, large-scale structure, and supernovae data. We find there are cosmologically viable regions of MAD parameter space that are consistent with laboratory and astrophysical bounds and also overlap with the EDGES-defined window. Although the EDGES result is likely not a Cosmic Dawn signal, MAD leaves distinctive cosmological signatures, accessible to upcoming 21-cm observations.

title: PRISMS GHZ8: Evidence for a Young Burst and Potential Merger Activity at z=10.23
background_knowledge: 宇宙大爆炸后最初十亿年（$z\gtrsim6$）是星系形成与宇宙再电离的关键时期。JWST 的 NIRCam 与 MIRI 可在红外波段探测高红移星系，并通过多波段测光、光谱证认、恒星族谱能量分布（SED）拟合、紫外连续谱斜率 $\beta_{\mathrm{UV}}$ 及氢复合线（如 Hα、Hβ）测量恒星质量、年龄、尘埃消光与瞬时恒星形成率。高红移紫外亮星系为何如此明亮、其恒星形成是平滑还是爆发式、以及是否由并合触发，是理解早期星系质量组装与再电离光子预算的核心问题。通常，年轻且贫尘埃的星族具有更蓝（更负）的紫外斜率，强 Hα 与 Hβ-[OIII] 发射线则指示近期大质量恒星形成；电离光子逃逸分数 $f_{\mathrm{esc}}$ 则关系到星系对再电离的贡献。引力透镜放大可提高暗弱高红移目标的探测率，但分析时必须将放大率 $\mu$ 计入光度、质量和大小。
contribution: 论文利用 JWST/MIRI LRS 对 $z=10.23$ 紫外亮星系 GHZ8（放大率 $\mu=1.23$）进行光谱观测。光谱以约 $5\sigma$ 探测到 Hβ-[OIII] 复合线、以约 $4\sigma$ 探测到 Hα 线，流量分别约为 $3.2\pm0.9\times10^{-18}\ \mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}\,cm^{-2}}$ 与 $1.7\pm0.4\times10^{-18}\ \mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}\,cm^{-2}}$。JWST/NIRCam 成像显示 GHZ8 由相距仅 $0.16^{\prime\prime}$（约 $600\ \mathrm{pc}$）的两部分组成：明亮延展的主成分 GHZ8-main 与暗弱致密的东南团块 GHZ8-SE。形态分解给出退放大后的 $M_{\mathrm{UV}}=-19.91\pm0.10\ \mathrm{mag}$ 与 $-18.03\pm0.15\ \mathrm{mag}$，以及紫外斜率 $\beta_{\mathrm{UV}}=-2.53\pm0.22$ 与 $-3.45\pm0.49$，表明两者均含年轻恒星族；尤其 GHZ8-SE 极蓝的紫外连续谱要求一个极年轻、贫星际介质且电离光子逃逸分数高（$f_{\mathrm{esc}}=0.6-1.0$）的恒星族。结合 UV 与 Hα 光度以及光谱-测光 SED 拟合，作者约束 GHZ8-main 的恒星形成活动，发现它要么处于**近期短时标恒星形成爆发的末期**，要么经历了**持续时间较短（$<50\ \mathrm{Myr}$）的连续恒星形成**。因此，GHZ8 为紫外亮星系中的**爆发式恒星形成**提供了观测证据；整体上它可能正在经历**并合触发的星暴**，但更明确的判断仍需更深成像或空间分辨运动学。
summary: UV-bright galaxies in the early Universe provide important constraints on the rapid build-up of stellar mass and the sources responsible for cosmic reionization. However, the physical processes that drive their high UV luminosities remain unclear. Here we report JWST/MIRI LRS spectroscopy of GHZ8, a UV-bright galaxy at z=10.23 with a magnification $μ=1.23$. The spectrum shows a $\sim 5σ$ detection for the $\rm Hβ$-[OIII] complex and $\sim 4σ$ for $\rm Hα$ line, with fluxes of $3.2\pm0.9\times10^{-18}$ and $\rm 1.7\pm0.4\times10^{-18}\,erg\,s^{-1}\,cm^{-2}$, respectively. Based on JWST/NIRCam imaging, we find that GHZ8 consists of two components separated only by 0.16" ($\approx600$ pc): a bright, extended main component and a faint, compact southeastern clump, hereafter referred to as GHZ8-main and GHZ8-SE. Through morphological decomposition, we find demagnified $M_{UV}=-19.91\pm0.10$ and $-18.03\pm0.15$ mag for GHZ8-main and GHZ8-SE, with blue UV slopes of $β_{UV}=-2.53\pm0.22$ and $-3.45\pm0.49$, respectively, indicating that both components host young stellar populations. In particular, the extremely blue UV continuum of GHZ8-SE requires an extremely young, ISM-poor stellar population with a high ionizing photon escape fraction, $f_{esc}= 0.6-1.0$. Combining the UV and $\rm Hα$ luminosities with the results from the spectro-photometric SED fitting, we constrain the star-formation activity of GHZ8-main, and find either a recent, short-lived burst of star formation that is now in its final phases, or continuous star formation over a relatively short period ($<50\,{\rm Myr}$). GHZ8 therefore provides observational evidence for bursty star formation in a UV-bright galaxy. Globally, GHZ8 may be undergoing a merger-induced starburst, although deeper imaging or spatially resolved kinematic information is required for a more definitive interpretation.

title: The IRAC Distant Cluster Survey
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大尺度的引力束缚天体，由暗物质晕、成员星系和高温团内介质组成，质量通常在 $10^{13}$–$10^{15} M_\odot$ 量级。它们在大尺度结构网络中作为高密度节点，其数目密度和丰度对宇宙膨胀史与结构增长敏感；团内星系演化、团内介质物理和并合历史也与暗物质、气体和恒星形成过程紧密相关。观测上，星系团可通过光学/红外波段的星系过密区和红序星系、X 射线的扩展热气体辐射，以及微波波段的 Sunyaev–Zel’dovich 效应来搜寻。现代宽视场巡天常利用多波段测光红移概率分布和聚类探测算法构建星表，再借助模拟刻画选择函数，包括纯度、完备度和质量阈值。光谱或 X 射线确认、速度弥散和弱引力透镜等质量代理用于校准候选体与暗物质晕质量之间的关系；主要系统误差包括投影与视线叠加、测光红移误差、成员星系误判以及探测阈值引起的选择偏置。
contribution: 本文发布 IRAC Distant Cluster Survey (IDCS) 星表，利用 PZWav 探测算法在 Boötes 天区的十二波段光学与红外成像中，基于测光红移概率分布识别出 **825 个星系团与星系群候选体**，覆盖 $0.08 < z < 2.0$，中位红移为 $z = 0.93$，其中 **147 个系统位于 $z \geq 1.5$**。模拟表明，在 $z < 1.5$ 且采用 S/N $\geq 4$ 阈值时，候选样本纯度约为 **93%**，在 $\log(M_{200c}/M_\odot) = 13.74 \pm 0.01$ 处的完备度约为 **50%**；与光谱数据比较得到测光红移精度 $\sigma_z/(1+z) = 0.017$。结合此前发表的 18 个 IRAC Shallow Cluster Survey (ISCS) 系统，**共有 80 个 IDCS 候选团已通过光谱和/或 X 射线确认**；DESI DR1 光谱给出 38 个系统的红移，其中 **23 个为新确认星系团**。这些 DESI 确认系统覆盖 $0.12 < z < 0.93$，每个至少含 10 个光谱成员，测得中位速度弥散 $\sim 490$ km s$^{-1}$，对应中位晕质量 $1.1 \times 10^{14} M_\odot$。与 39 个独立确认的文献星系团比较，中心位置偏移的中位值为 211 kpc。该星表覆盖宽红移范围，选择函数经模拟刻画，是研究大尺度结构、致密环境中的星系演化以及校准 LSST、Roman 和 Euclid 等当前与未来宽视场巡天星系团探测技术的有价值资源。
summary: We present the Infrared Array Camera (IRAC) Distant Cluster Survey (IDCS), a catalog of 825 galaxy cluster and group candidates identified in the Boötes field using the PZWav detection code. Candidates are selected using photometric redshift probability distributions derived from twelve-band optical and infrared imaging. The catalog spans $0.08 < z < 2.0$ (median $z = 0.93$) and includes 147 systems at $z \geq 1.5$. For $z < 1.5$, simulations indicate a purity of $93\%$ at the adopted S/N $\geq 4$ threshold and $50\%$ completeness at $\log(M_{200c}/M_\odot) = 13.74 \pm 0.01$. We validate the cluster photometric redshifts through comparison with spectroscopic data, finding $σ_z/(1+z)=0.017$. Including 18 previously published IRAC Shallow Cluster Survey (ISCS) systems, a total of 80 IDCS cluster candidates are now confirmed through spectroscopy and/or X-ray observations. DESI DR1 spectroscopy provides redshifts for 38 systems, including 23 newly confirmed clusters. These DESI-confirmed systems span $0.12 < z < 0.93$ and have at least 10 spectroscopic members each, from which we measure a median velocity dispersion of $\sim 490$ km s$^{-1}$, corresponding to a median halo mass of $1.1 \times 10^{14} M_\odot$. A positional comparison with 39 independently confirmed literature clusters yields a median centroid offset of 211 kpc. The IDCS catalog provides a cluster sample spanning a wide redshift range, with a selection function characterized through simulations and is a valuable resource for studies of large-scale structure, galaxy evolution in dense environments, and the calibration of cluster detection techniques for current and upcoming wide-field surveys, including LSST, Roman, and Euclid.

title: Age-Resolved Vertical Motions in the Milky Way Warp: A Localized Enhancement in Intermediate-Age Populations
background_knowledge: 银河系盘并非理想平面，外盘的中平面在银心距较大处相对内盘发生系统性抬升或下沉，并在视线速度或垂直速度场中留下特征，这就是银河系翘曲（warp）。翘曲可由卫星星系潮汐、暗物质晕错位、盘内不稳定性或角动量吸积等激发；其形态和运动学随半径、方位与星族年龄变化，因而可把恒星年龄当作“动力学时钟”，反推扰动开始时间、传播方式及盘的垂直结构。研究上通常结合大规模光谱巡天获得的恒星参数与年龄、Gaia 天体测量与距离，在柱坐标 $(R, \varphi, Z)$ 中测量平均垂直速度 $V_Z$ 随 $R$ 的剖面，并与经典造父变星、疏散星团等年轻示踪体交叉检验。不同年龄群体若经历同一持续翘曲，其 $V_Z$ 剖面可因年龄—速度弥散—垂直结构差异而不同；若翘曲在较早时期已启动，老星族可能保留更早扰动的印记。该方向连接银河系薄盘与厚盘动力学、外盘结构、暗物质晕形状及星系盘形成演化。
contribution: 论文利用 APOGEE DR19 光谱为 222,355 颗红巨星估计年龄，并结合 Gaia 天体测量与几何距离，选取其中 168,824 颗星，按 $0$–$10$ Gyr 分为五个年龄箱，测量与翘曲相关的径向 $V_Z$ 剖面。年轻红巨星（$0$–$2$ Gyr）的剖面与经典造父变星及年轻疏散星团总体一致。**在 $9 \leq R < 12$ kpc 范围内，中等年龄红巨星（$2$–$4$ 和 $4$–$6$ Gyr）的平均 $V_Z$ 分别比年轻群体高 $1.48 \pm 0.46$ 和 $1.49 \pm 0.52$ km s$^{-1}$**；而在 $R \simeq 12$–$13$ kpc 处，$0$–$6$ Gyr 红巨星的 $V_Z$ 剖面在不确定度内一致。该中等年龄增强在稳健性检验中持续存在，**可能反映中等年龄星族具有更小的有效运动学翘曲起始半径**。作者指出，观测到的速度差异可能来自早期扰动与现今翘曲的共同作用，也可能源于不同星族垂直结构的差异。
summary: Determining how the Milky Way warp evolves provides constraints on the formation and dynamical evolution of galactic disks. Using Apache Point Observatory Galactic Evolution Experiment Data Release 19 (APOGEE DR19) spectroscopy, we estimate ages for 222,355 red giants. With Gaia astrometry and geometric distances, we analyze 168,824 of these stars in five age bins spanning $0$--$10$ Gyr. The warp-related radial vertical-velocity ($V_Z$) profile of young red giants ($0$--$2$ Gyr) is broadly consistent with those of classical Cepheids and young open clusters. Over $9\leq R<12$ kpc, we find that the mean $V_Z$ values of the intermediate-age red giants ($2$--$4$ and $4$--$6$ Gyr) are $1.48\pm0.46$ and $1.49\pm0.52$ km s$^{-1}$ higher than that of the young population, respectively. By contrast, at $R\simeq12$--$13$ kpc, the $V_Z$ profiles of the $0$--$6$ Gyr red giants are consistent within their uncertainties. The intermediate-age enhancement persists across our robustness tests and may reflect smaller effective kinematic warp onset radii for the intermediate-age populations. The observed velocity differences may arise from the combined effects of earlier perturbations and the present-day warp, or from differences in vertical structure among stellar populations.

title: Unveiling the Shock-Excited Molecular Environment in the Orion Protostar HOPS 370
background_knowledge: 深埋原恒星形成于冷分子云核的引力坍缩过程中，处于 Class 0/I 阶段时仍被尘埃包层强烈遮蔽，同时通过吸积驱动外流。外流与周围云气碰撞形成激波，将气体加热到数百至数千 K，并在近红外产生分子氢 $H_2$ 的振转发射线；这些线是探测被尘埃遮蔽的激波、外流与气体冷却过程的重要窗口。研究范式通常包括：用 K 波段光谱测量 $H_2$ 的 S 支与 Q 支跃迁，借助同一上能级跃迁估计尘埃消光，利用线比区分热激发与紫外荧光，并在光学薄、局部热动平衡近似下构建激发图，反演激发温度、柱密度及正-仲氢比，从而约束激波物理和原恒星活动历史。
contribution: 该文利用 3.6 m Devasthal 光学望远镜上的 TANSPEC 对 Orion 深埋原恒星 HOPS 370 开展近红外 K 波段（ $1.94$--$2.52$ $\mu$m ）光谱观测，探测到由 $1$--$0$ S、$2$--$1$ S 和 $1$--$0$ Q 支多条跃迁主导的显著 $H_2$ 振转发射。借助来自同一上能级的 $1$--$0$ Q(3) 与 $1$--$0$ S(1) 跃迁，得到 $A_V = 23.24 \pm 1.25$ mag（ $A_K = 2.50 \pm 0.13$ mag ），与源的深埋 Class 0/I 性质一致；诊断线比 $F(2\!-\!1\,{\rm S}(1))/F(1\!-\!0\,{\rm S}(1)) = 0.12 \pm 0.01$ 与热激发相符，**不支持紫外荧光作为主导激发机制**。在光学薄和局部热动平衡假设下，激发图给出 **激发温度 $2078 \pm 215$ K** 与 **分子氢柱密度 $(1.93 \pm 0.93)\times10^{20}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-2}$**，并得到正-仲氢比 $2.45 \pm 0.21$，表明存在 **显著的激波热加工**，但仍低于高温平衡值 3。综合诊断表明，HOPS 370 的 $H_2$ 发射主要起源于 **暖的激波加热气体，最可能与其原恒星外流相关**；该工作展示了联合 S、Q 支 $H_2$ 光谱在约束深埋原恒星系统物理条件与激发历史方面的诊断能力。
summary: We present near-infrared K-band ($1.94$--$2.52~μ$m) spectroscopy of the deeply embedded protostellar source HOPS\,370, obtained with the TIFR--ARIES Near Infrared Spectrometer (TANSPEC) on the 3.6-m Devasthal Optical Telescope (DOT). The spectrum is dominated by prominent molecular hydrogen ($\rm H_2$) ro-vibrational emission, with multiple transitions detected from the $1$--$0$ S, $2$--$1$ S, and $1$--$0$ Q branches. Using the intrinsically linked $\rm H_2$ $1$--$0$ Q(3) and $1$--$0$ S(1) transitions, which arise from the same upper energy level, we derive a visual extinction of $A_V = 23.24 \pm 1.25$ mag, corresponding to $A_K = 2.50 \pm 0.13$ mag, consistent with the embedded Class~0/I nature of the source. The diagnostic line ratio $F(2$--$1~{\rm S}(1))/F(1$--$0~{\rm S}(1)) = 0.12 \pm 0.01$ is consistent with thermal excitation and disfavors ultraviolet fluorescence as the dominant excitation mechanism. Assuming optically thin emission and local thermodynamic equilibrium, we derive an $\rm H_2$ excitation diagram that yields an excitation temperature of $2078 \pm 215$ K and a molecular hydrogen column density of $(1.93 \pm 0.93)\times10^{20}$ cm$^{-2}$. We further derive an ortho-to-para ratio of $2.45 \pm 0.21$, indicating substantial shock-driven thermal processing while remaining below the high-temperature equilibrium value of 3. Taken together, these diagnostics indicate that the molecular hydrogen emission in HOPS\,370 originates predominantly in warm, shock-heated gas most likely associated with its protostellar outflow. Our results demonstrate the diagnostic power of combined S- and Q-branch $\rm H_2$ spectroscopy for constraining the physical conditions and excitation history of deeply embedded protostellar systems.

title: Model of the instrumental polarization induced by a rotating HWP with anti-reflective sub-wavelength structures for CMB polarimetry
background_knowledge:
宇宙微波背景（CMB）是早期宇宙复合时期释放的遗余辐射，其温度和偏振各向异性记录了宇宙膨胀历史、原初扰动以及再电离等信息。偏振由 CMB 光子与自由电子发生 Thomson 散射产生，可分解为 $E$ 模和 $B$ 模：$E$ 模主要由密度扰动产生，而原初 $B$ 模是暴胀期原初引力波留下的独特印记，也是检验早期宇宙物理的重要探针。原初 $B$ 模信号极其微弱，因此 CMB 偏振实验必须把仪器系统误差控制在极低水平。
\n旋转半波片（HWP）是 CMB 偏振测量的重要技术：它通过连续旋转调制入射偏振，把偏振信号搬到与旋转频率相关的谐波上，从而与探测器漂移、大气和扫描等低频系统误差分离。然而，真实 HWP 并非理想光学元件，其多层结构、反射、吸收、各向异性以及抗反射亚波长结构（SWS）都会产生非理想电磁响应，形成与 HWP 旋转同步的仪器偏振。此类仪器偏振可能泄漏到 $B$ 模重建中，尤其是四次谐波项，是 CMB 偏振实验重点关注和缓解的系统误差来源。
\n抗反射 SWS 通过在晶体表面引入亚波长周期结构来降低反射损耗，其几何轮廓、周期、填充因子和非对称性会影响透射率、偏振效率、延迟量（retardance）以及 Mueller 矩阵响应。严格耦合波分析（RCWA）是求解周期亚波长结构 Maxwell 方程的标准方法，可用于计算多层蓝宝石 HWP 的透射、反射、偏振调制和仪器偏振响应，为实验设计及系统误差预算提供依据。
contribution: 本文针对用于 CMB 偏振测量的多层蓝宝石 HWP，建立了含抗反射 SWS 的仪器偏振响应模型，并利用严格耦合波分析（RCWA）计算其电磁响应。研究比较了三种非对称 SWS 模型，发现 **并未出现可归因于 SWS 非对称类型的透射率、偏振效率或仪器偏振响应的显著差异**。对于 CMB 偏振重建至关重要的四次谐波仪器偏振，在 CMB 频段通常为 $10^{-4}$ 量级，**预期可以通过后续分析加以抑制**。作者还评估了一种实际制备的 SWS 几何结构，其非对称性会增强延迟量，并将其响应与具有同类非对称性的理想化模型进行比较。实际 SWS 与理想模型的对比表明，**较高透射率倾向于对应较低的仪器偏振**。这些结果提示，**改善总透射率（包括实际制备 SWS 轮廓的影响）可能比调节 SWS 非对称性本身更有利于降低 HWP 引起的仪器偏振**。
summary: Future CMB polarization experiments require precise control of instrumental systematics in the search for primordial $B$-mode polarization. A rotating half-wave plate (HWP) provides effective polarization modulation, but its non-ideal electromagnetic response can generate HWP-synchronous instrumental polarization. In this work, we characterize the response of a multi-layer sapphire HWP with anti-reflective sub-wavelength structures (SWS) using rigorous coupled-wave analysis. For three asymmetric SWS models, we find no substantial differences in the transmittance, polarization efficiency, or instrumental-polarization response that can be attributed to the type of SWS asymmetry. The fourth-harmonic instrumental polarization relevant to CMB polarization reconstruction is typically of order $10^{-4}$ in the CMB bands, which is expected to be mitigated. We further evaluate an actually fabricated SWS geometry, whose asymmetry enhances the retardance, and compare its response with that of an idealized model having the same type of asymmetry. Comparison of the realistic SWS with the idealized model shows that higher transmittance tends to be associated with lower instrumental polarization. These results suggest that improving the total transmission, including the effect of the fabricated SWS profile, may be more important for reducing HWP-induced instrumental polarization than tuning the SWS asymmetry itself.

title: Experimental Demonstration of Double-Fourier Interferometer Imaging for Future Space-Based Far-Infrared Observatories
background_knowledge: 远红外（Far-Infrared, FIR）天文学观测的是被尘埃加热的冷天体与高遮蔽区域的热辐射，是研究恒星形成、活动星系核（AGN）以及原行星盘的关键窗口。其核心困难在于 FIR 波长长，衍射极限角分辨率由 $\theta \approx 1.22\lambda/D$ 决定；在空间平台上虽避开大气吸收，但要达到高分辨率仍需要极大口径或干涉测量。干涉测量通过多个望远镜基线的复条纹可见度采样目标的空间频率，再经孔径合成重建图像；傅里叶变换光谱仪（FTS）则通过扫描光程差获得宽带光谱。双傅里叶干涉仪（Double-Fourier Interferometer, DFI）把空间干涉与 FTS 结合：对不同基线的干涉信号随光程差扫描，同时编码空间频率与光谱频率，从而在一次观测中获得高分辨率宽带光谱图像。该方向的研究范式包括实验室或样机验证、系统误差标定（强度不平衡、相位误差、相位中心偏移）、探测器阵列拼接宽视场，以及面向未来空间远红外天文台的系统集成与定标。
contribution: 论文报道了在 0.3 至 2.1 THz 光学带宽的实验室测试平台上对 DFI 关键观测技术的系统验证。作者给出了仪器的理想响应，并建立了针对强度不平衡、非线性相位误差与相位中心偏移的标定方法。实验**成功实现了一维与二维目标的孔径合成，并准确恢复源几何结构**；通过在一维扩展源上使用低通光学滤光片，**证明了仪器对空间依赖光谱变化的敏感能力**；同时利用探测器阵列中独立像素分别响应源面不同区域的数据组合，**验证了宽视场成像能力**。实验数据与理论预测总体吻合，残余偏差可归因于光学像差与透视效应。上述结果表明，**DFI 架构是面向未来空间远红外天文台的高能力且成熟的技术方案**。
summary: Far-infrared (FIR) astronomy is crucial for observing star formation, active galactic nuclei, and protoplanetary systems, but its effectiveness is severely limited by poor diffraction-limited spatial resolution. To overcome this limitation, a double-Fourier interferometer (DFI), which couples a spatial interferometer with a Fourier transform spectrometer, has been proposed to deliver high-resolution broadband spectral imaging. Despite various conceptual and prototype studies, a comprehensive demonstration of DFI capabilities has been lacking. In this study, we present the validation of key DFI observing techniques using a laboratory testbed operating in the 0.3 to 2.1 THz optical bandwidth. We detail the instrument's ideal response alongside necessary calibrations for intensity imbalances, non-linear phase errors, and phase-center offsets. Our experimental results successfully demonstrate aperture synthesis for both one- and two-dimensional targets, accurately recovering source geometries. Furthermore, we prove the instrument's sensitivity to spatially dependent spectral variations by utilizing a low-pass optical filter on extended sources. Finally, we validate wide-field imaging capabilities by combining data from independent pixels in a detector array, each sensitive to different regions of the source plane. The experimental data show significant agreement with theoretical predictions, with minor deviations attributed to optical aberrations and perspective effects. These laboratory demonstrations validate the DFI architecture as a highly capable and mature technology for future space-based FIR observatories.

title: Tidal shells as clocks of galaxy mergers and tests of cosmological models
background_knowledge: 在等级结构形成框架下，星系通过并合逐步增长，并在宿主星系引力势中留下潮汐尾、壳层、流等遗迹。恒星壳层是并合后较长时间尺度上可保存的同心弧状结构，其形态与间距记录并合事件的时间、轨道以及宿主引力势，因此可被视为“星系并合时钟”。研究通常把近邻星系的深成像壳层统计与宇宙学模拟中的并合历史、恒星分布和引力势演化相比较，以检验星系形成模型及宇宙学框架下的结构增长。大质量长椭球旋转体（prolate rotators）常被认为与并合历史有关，是检验壳层与并合时间关系的合适样本。
contribution: 论文从两个互补角度比较观测与宇宙学模拟中的壳层系统。首先，作者指出模拟预言存在大量尺度 $>100\ \mathrm{kpc}$ 的超大壳层，而观测中这类壳层很少见，**这揭示了模拟与现实之间可能存在的重要差异**。由于观测与模拟壳层系统的尺度显著不同，作者转而重点比较并合历史：利用壳层识别方法估计一批近邻大质量长椭球旋转体的并合时间，并与宇宙学模拟给出的并合历史进行对照。论文还介绍了利用 Milankovic telescope 深成像扩展长椭球旋转体样本的进展，为未来基于更大观测样本的研究奠定基础。
summary: Stellar shells-concentric arc-like tidal features formed in galaxy mergers-provide a valuable record of recent galaxy assembly histories encoding both the merger event and the gravitational potential of the host galaxy. We compare shell systems in observations and cosmological simulations from two complementary perspectives. First, we show that simulations predict a substantial population of very large (>100kpc) shells that are rarely observed, revealing a potentially important discrepancy between simulations and reality. Because the scales of observed and simulated shell systems differ significantly, we focus on a comparison of merger histories. Using a shell-identification method, we estimate merger times for a sample of nearby massive prolate rotators and compare them with merger histories derived from cosmological simulations. We also present ongoing efforts to expand the sample of deeply imaged prolate rotators using observations from the Milankovic telescope, paving the way for future studies based on larger observational samples.

title: Identifying Scientifically Interesting Galaxies with Vision-Language Models
background_knowledge: 大型星系巡天持续产生海量图像，星系形态与多波段性质记录了质量组装、恒星形成、并合、环境剥离和黑洞反馈等过程。强引力透镜、水母星系、可见喷流等稀有现象分别连接暗物质分布、环境效应与活动星系核物理。传统研究范式依赖成像巡天、形态分类、光谱与多波段证认以及统计样本分析；异常搜索则利用监督或无监督机器学习从海量图像中挑出离群对象，但统计上最稀有的对象不一定具有最高科学价值。视觉-语言模型通过图文对比学习获得跨模态语义表示，可用自然语言提示进行零样本分类与排序，为按科研兴趣筛选图像提供新路径；其评估需关注召回率、纯度、推理成本与可复现性。
contribution: 论文研究预训练视觉-语言模型能否直接从自然语言指令评估星系图像的科学价值，从而在无需标注样本的情况下对图像排序。作者在一个包含 20,000 张 Hubble Space Telescope 图像、并有 167 个经机器学习与专家检查确认的参考异常的样本上进行评测。Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 按科学兴趣打分后，将 **98.2% 的参考异常排进最高约 2,000 张图像内**，当前推理成本约为每 10,000 张图像 5.05 美元。该方法**重新发现了已知引力透镜、水母星系候选以及具有可见喷流的星系**，并**发布 102 个高分候选**供后续研究。结果表明，**无需在目标数据上训练的现成视觉-语言模型，即可按科学相关性而非单纯稀有性对大型图像数据集排序**，提供了一条实用途径。项目代码公开于 https://github.com/TheCheng2005/Galaxy-Anomaly-Search/。
summary: Anomaly searches in large astronomical image datasets aim to identify rare objects for follow-up investigation. Yet the objects that are most statistically unusual are not necessarily those of greatest scientific relevance. We investigate whether pretrained vision-language models can directly assess scientific interest from natural-language instructions, enabling galaxy images to be ranked without labeled examples. We evaluate models on a 20,000-image Hubble Space Telescope sample that includes 167 reference anomalies previously identified through machine learning and expert inspection. By scoring images for scientific interest, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite places 98.2% of the reference anomalies within the highest-ranked ~2,000 images, at a present-day inference cost of approximately $5.05 per 10,000 images. We recover known gravitational lenses, jellyfish-galaxy candidates, and galaxies with visible jets, and release 102 high-scoring candidates for further investigation. These results show that an off-the-shelf vision-language model, without any training on the target data, offers a practical way to rank large image datasets by scientific relevance rather than rarity. The project code is available at https://github.com/TheCheng2005/Galaxy-Anomaly-Search/

title: Probing Cosmology with Diffusion Models: Memorization, Generalization, and Parameter Estimation
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学通过观测宇宙中的物质与辐射分布，并借助统计推断来约束宇宙学参数。大尺度结构研究关注星系、中性氢（HI）等示踪物在宇宙学尺度上的成团性，其常用统计量包括一点统计量（如像素值分布）和两点统计量（如功率谱 $P(k)$）。理论上，需要依靠宇宙学流体动力学模拟来预言不同参数下的场分布；但高分辨率模拟计算昂贵，因此常用神经代理模型或生成模型加速。CAMELS IllustrisTNG 是一套系统改变宇宙学与天体物理参数的大规模模拟集合，常用于训练和检验此类代理模型。扩散模型（diffusion models）通过逆转加噪过程学习数据分布，可生成逼真的模拟场。然而，生成样本视觉逼真或低阶统计量一致，并不等于模型可用于科学推断。科学推断要求模型学到可泛化的物理映射，而非记住训练样本；同时，由代理模型得到的参数后验密度必须校准，即其可信区间应与真实参数误差分布相符。若训练集过小，生成模型可能记忆训练样本，并导致后验过度自信或失准。因此，记忆、泛化与统计校准是评估生成式代理模型能否用于宇宙学参数估计的关键问题。
contribution: 论文在 CAMELS IllustrisTNG 模拟的 HI 场上训练扩散模型，并在固定模型规模下改变训练集大小，系统考察三方面性质：对单个训练样本的记忆、生成场与一点和两点统计量（像素值分布与功率谱）的一致性，以及从生成场估计宇宙学参数的表现。结果表明，训练数据较少且多样性不足时，模型会产生记忆样本；虽然记忆现象本身已知，但作者进一步证明这会导致宇宙学推断中的参数密度失准。对于固定模型规模，存在一个具有足够信息量的训练集规模，使模型能够泛化，此时神经代理模型的后验密度估计可以良好校准。**因此，一个神经代理模型可能通过视觉检查、一点统计量和功率谱收敛检验，却在宇宙学推断管线中给出过度自信的参数估计；泛化性测试应作为采用神经代理模型的推断流程的额外检查。**
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used as surrogates for expensive cosmological simulations, but simple metrics like reconstruction fidelity do not guarantee a surrogate can be trusted for scientific inference. To explore this, we train diffusion models on HI fields from the CAMELS IllustrisTNG simulations and test how three properties change with training-set size: memorization of individual training examples, agreement with one- and two-point statistics (the pixel-value distribution and the power spectrum), and estimation of cosmological parameters from the generated fields. At fixed model size, generative models trained with smaller, less diverse training data produced memorized samples. While this is a well known phenomenon, we show that this leads to miscalibrated parameter densities for cosmological inference tasks. At fixed size, there is a training set size with enough information content to enable a model to generalize, at which point posterior density estimation with neural surrogates can be well-calibrated. We demonstrate that a neural surrogate can therefore pass visual, one-point and power-spectrum convergence tests while still resulting in overconfident parameter estimation in a cosmological inference pipeline. Thus, tests of model generalization should be an additional check for inference pipelines adopting neural surrogates.

title: Simulation-Informed Dust Masses in Typical $6<z<14$ JWST Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化中的星际尘埃由渐近巨星分支星和超新星产生，并在星际介质中经历增长、凝聚、冲击摧毁与热气体溅射等过程；尘埃会吸收和散射星光，使静止系紫外与光学波段出现衰减，并以红外连续谱再辐射。高红移星系尘埃研究的关键难点是：在 $z>6$ 时，典型星系尘埃质量低、角分辨率与灵敏度受限，ALMA 往往只能给出上限，而 JWST 的深场测光与光谱可提供静止系 UV/optical 衰减信息。传统由银河系标定的尘埃质量—衰减关系依赖尘埃-金属丰度比、尘埃几何分布、粒径分布与星族性质，可能不适用于早期星系。宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟可在星系尺度上实时演化尘埃粒子，并正向预测恒星半光半径、衰减与尘埃质量之间的关系，为高红移观测提供物理校准。
contribution: 论文指出，尽管静止系 UV/optical 光谱与测光显示典型 $z>8$ 星系中存在尘埃，直接探测其尘埃仍不可行。作者基于尘埃粒子实时演化的宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟，提出一种利用恒星半光半径与 UV/optical 衰减推断高红移星系尘埃质量的新方法；该方法能重现较低红移下的观测趋势，但与基于银河系的校准因子相比可偏离达 $\sim1.5\,\mathrm{dex}$。将其应用于 JWST 观测的 $6<z<14$ 星系后，得到 **尘埃质量约为 $M_{\mathrm{dust}}\sim10^{3}-10^{5}\,M_{\odot}$**，且 **与 ALMA 上限完全一致**；结果还暗示 **早期由超新星主导的尘埃增丰，随后在热气体中发生高效尘埃摧毁**。作者给出可供未来观测使用的表格化校准，以在较宽恒星质量与红移范围内推断尘埃质量。
summary: Direct detections of dust in typical $z>8$ galaxies remain untenable, despite the presence of dust suggested by rest-frame UV/optical spectro-photometry. Informed by cosmological zoom-in simulations where dust particles evolve on-the-fly, we present a novel method for inferring dust masses in high-redshift galaxies using stellar half-light radii and UV/optical attenuation. Our methods reproduce observed trends at lower redshift, ultimately diverging from Milky Way-based calibration factors by up to $\sim1.5$ dex. We apply this method to observed JWST galaxies from $6<z<14$, and find dust masses in the range $M_{\rm dust}\sim10^3-10^5\,M_\odot$ that are fully consistent with upper limits from ALMA, and suggest an early dust enrichment period by supernovae followed by efficient grain destruction in the hot gas. Future observations may use our tabulated calibration to infer dust masses over a wide range of stellar masses and redshifts.

title: Ejected and Rejected: Strong Scatterings in Dense Star Clusters
background_knowledge: 致密星团是研究恒星多体动力学的重要实验室。在球状星团与核星团中，恒星和致密天体的轨道演化主要受两体弛豫支配：大量弱、小角散射不断改变天体的能量 $E$ 与角动量 $J$，驱动质量分层、恒星抛射以及损失锥（loss cone）的填充与屏蔽。损失锥指一旦进入就会与中心大质量黑洞相遇、从而产生潮汐瓦解事件（tidal disruption event，TDE）、极端质量比旋近（extreme mass ratio inspiral，EMRI）或被抛射的轨道相空间区域。通常用各向同性、球对称分布函数描述星团背景，并通过 Fokker–Planck 或 Monte Carlo 方法计算扩散过程。除弱散射外，罕见但强烈的近遇可产生大速度踢和大角度偏转，可能显著改变个别天体的命运，因此需要定量比较强散射与弱散射的相对重要性。
contribution: 论文系统评估强散射在致密星团中的天体物理重要性。作者针对可代表球状星团与核星团的各向同性、球对称分布函数，推导了强散射所致速度踢的精确微分速率分布，并给出该分布的边界与近似速率标度关系；随后把形式推广到核星团中天体所受能量踢与角动量踢的近似速率。将该框架用于两类问题后，作者发现：（i）在某些参数区域，抛射率行为因强踢分布饱和及弱散射极限失效而变得复杂，**这可能增强损失锥屏蔽效应**；（ii）**相当比例的原初 EMRI（proto-EMRI）可能被强散射取消**，说明未来需要进一步确定强散射对真实 EMRI 形成率的影响程度。
summary: Understanding the evolution of collisional stellar systems is key to predicting both the bulk evolution of dense star clusters and also the rates of tidal disruption events, extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs), stellar ejections, and other loss cone phenomena. Although a majority of the evolution is dictated by weak, small-angle scatterings, rare close encounters resulting in strong scatterings can sometimes produce qualitatively different outcomes. To systematically determine the astrophysical importance of strong scatterings, we derive the exact differential rate distribution of velocity kicks in isotropic and spherically symmetric distribution functions representing globular and nuclear star clusters, while also deriving the distribution boundaries and approximate rate scalings. We then extend this formalism to derive approximate rates of energy and angular momentum kicks for objects in the nuclear star cluster, and then apply this framework to study (i) ejections and (ii) ``cancellation'' of extreme mass ratio inspirals. We find that ejection rates are complicated in some regimes due to the saturation of the strong kick distribution and the breakdown of the weak limit, likely enhancing the effect of loss cone shielding. We also determine that a sizable fraction of proto-EMRIs will likely be canceled by strong scatterings, highlighting the need for future work to determine to what degree strong scatterings impact the true EMRI rate.

title: Not so dead after all: young stars in the massive S0 NGC 3115
background_knowledge: 大质量早期型星系（ETGs，包括椭圆星系与 S0 型透镜星系）在光学波段通常由年老、低质量恒星主导，呈现“红而沉寂”的形态；传统图像认为它们的气体供应与恒星形成早已停止。然而，紫外（UV）连续谱和吸收线可以揭示少量年轻大质量恒星，或演化后期的高温星（如极端水平分支星），因此成为检验残余恒星形成、气体冷却与重循环的关键窗口。该领域常用星族合成与谱线强度拟合，将观测光谱分解为不同年龄、金属丰度和 $[\alpha/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 的星族，并借助贝叶斯推断估计各成分质量占比；难点在于年轻星与高温老年星在 UV 上可能简并，且需要空间分辨数据约束其分布。
contribution: 论文利用 SOAR/Goodman 光谱与谱线强度拟合，对 NGC 3115 的恒星形成历史建模：以单一主体年老星族叠加一个过去 1 Gyr 内恒定恒星形成的年轻成分，并用 UltraNest 采样年龄、金属丰度、$[\alpha/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 与年轻星质量分数的后验分布。通过追踪 U 波段指数的空间变化，作者发现年轻星质量分数在中心达到 $0.69^{+0.09}_{-0.15}\%$，并在 1 kpc 以外降为零；该年轻成分与运动学结构相关，在压力支撑区占主导。作者将其解释为内部过程（如恒星抛射物循环利用）驱动的残余中心恒星形成；极端水平分支星等替代 UV 增亮模型拟合更差且给出非物理的高质量分数。**因此，年老“红而沉寂”星系中的年轻星比预期更普遍；不同早期型星系中类似梯度的存在表明残余恒星形成是普遍特征，并为这些星系的二重子循环提供了关键约束。**
summary: Context: Massive early-type galaxies (ETGs) are traditionally considered "red-and-dead" based on optical observations. However, ultraviolet (UV) spectroscopy can uncover a hidden population of young stars with a sub-one-per cent mass fraction. Aims: We measure the young stellar mass fraction in NGC 3115, a massive isolated lenticular galaxy, to test the ubiquity and spatial distribution of this component beyond previously studied ellipticals. Methods: Using SOAR/Goodman spectra and line-strength fitting, we modelled the star-formation history with a single bulk stellar population plus a young component (constant star-formation over the last 1 Gyr). We used ultranest to derive posterior distributions for age, metallicity, [Mg/Fe], and the young stellar mass fraction. Results: By tracking spatial variations in U-band indices, we found the young stellar mass fraction peaks at $0.69^{+0.09}_{-0.15}\%$ in the centre, dropping to zero beyond 1 kpc. This young component correlates with kinematic structures, dominating in the pressure-supported region. We interpret this as residual central star formation fueled by internal processes, such as recycled stellar material. Alternative UV-bright models (e.g., extreme horizontal branch stars) yielded poorer fits and unphysically high mass fractions. Conclusions: Young stars in old, "red-and-dead" galaxies are more common than expected. Their presence across various ETGs with similar gradients indicates that residual star formation is a ubiquitous feature, offering key constraints on the baryon cycle in these galaxies.

title: Extra! Extra! X-ray Emission!: X-rays in Romulus25, Part II - Physical Drivers of X-ray Emission in the CGM
background_knowledge: 星系周介质（CGM）是星系盘之外、维里半径以内、由多相气体与金属组成的环境，也是星系吸积、外流、冷却与反馈相互作用的关键界面。对于银河系质量（MW-mass）星系，CGM 的热相温度约为 $T \sim 10^{6}\ \mathrm{K}$，主要以软 X 射线热韧致辐射和金属线发射被探测；其 X 射线表面亮度与发射率取决于热气体的密度、温度、金属丰度以及观测投影。现代星系形成研究通常借助宇宙学流体模拟，在暗物质晕形成与星系演化的背景下追踪气体加热、冷却、恒星形成、恒星反馈和 AGN 反馈，并用 zoom-in 或受控模拟分离物理机制。Romulus25 与 PIONEER 正属于这一研究范式：前者提供大样本宇宙学模拟，后者通过遗传修正技术构造可控的 MW-mass 星系样本，用于解释统计相关背后的物理驱动。
contribution: 本文是“X-rays in Romulus25”系列第二篇，聚焦 L$_*$ 星系，旨在拆解 Romulus25（R25）模拟中星系晕内热 X 射线气体产生的具体物理过程。作者发现，热 CGM 气体质量 $M_{\mathrm{gas},\,T>10^{5.5}\ \mathrm{K}}$ 与第一篇文章定义的 X 射线发射率 $\varepsilon_{\chi}$ 呈强相关，并且二者还与热 CGM 的平均金属丰度 $\bar{Z}_{\mathrm{gas},\,T>10^{5.5}\ \mathrm{K}}$ 存在次级相关。借助 Sanchez et al. (2019) 的 PIONEER 模拟（采用 Roth et al. (2016) 的遗传修正技术、与 R25 相同的物理模型）进行解释后，文章指出热 X 射线气体的存在由两个关键过程决定：1）热 CGM 气体质量由**恒星反馈与 AGN 反馈的总能量注入共同设定**；2）热 CGM 的平均温度与金属丰度共同改变软 X 射线谱，使得在相同 $M_{\mathrm{gas},\,T>10^{5.5}\ \mathrm{K}}$ 下，**金属富集的 CGM 更亮、金属贫乏的 CGM 更暗**。这些结果首次表明，**金属富集的气体晕可能使 MW-mass 星系的 X 射线观测产生偏差**。
summary: Characterizing the hot (T ~ 10$^{6}$ K) circumgalactic medium (CGM) around Milky Way-mass (MW-mass) galaxies is critical to a full understanding of galaxy evolution. In this second paper of the "X-rays in Romulus25" series, we unpack the specific physical processes giving rise to the presence of hot X-ray emitting gas in the halos of galaxies from the Romulus25 (R25) simulation, focusing on L$_{*}$ galaxies. We determine that a strong correlation appears between the mass of hot CGM gas, M$_{gas, T > 10^{5.5} K}$, and the X-ray emissivity, $ε_χ$, measured in the first paper of this series, (Sanchez et al. 2026a, submitted). There is also a secondary correlation between M$_{gas, T > 10^{5.5} K}$ and $ε_χ$ with the average metallicity of the hot CGM gas, $\bar{Z}_{gas, T > 10^{5.5} K}$. We use the well-studied PIONEER simulations from Sanchez et al. (2019), a set of zoom-in MW-mass galaxies run with the genetic modification technique of Roth et al. (2016) and the same physics as R25, to interpret these correlations. We determine that the presence of hot X-ray emitting gas is determined by two key processes: 1) the quantity of hot gas mass in the CGM, M$_{gas, T > 10^{5.5} K}$, is set by the combined total energy injection of $both$ stellar and AGN feedback, and 2) together the average temperature and metallicity of the hot CGM changes the soft X-ray spectrum of the gas resulting in brighter metal-rich CGM and dimmer metal-poor CGM for the same quantity of M$_{gas, T > 10^{5.5} K}$. These results indicate, for the first time, that metal-rich gas halos may bias X-ray observations of MW-mass galaxies.

title: Resolving the thermal component of stellar feedback with the "anchor-and-refine" scheme in galactic simulations
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕中的重子物质如何冷却、凝聚成盘并形成恒星，以及恒星反馈、黑洞反馈和并合等过程如何改变星系的质量、形态与星族性质。恒星反馈由大质量恒星的星风、电离辐射和超新星爆炸提供，向星际介质注入能量、动量和重元素。若多个超新星在致密星团中接连爆发，高温低压气体可吹出“超泡”，并可能汇合为星系尺度外流，调节恒星形成与重子循环。数值模拟需要同时覆盖星系尺度与单个超新星冷却尺度；分辨不足时，热反馈能量可能在数值上被过早辐射掉，或只能以动量形式加入，导致对热气体、超泡内部结构和外流相态的描述不完整。因此，发展保热、分辨率自适应的亚网格反馈方案，并用理想化测试、孤立星系和宇宙学模拟检验其收敛性，是该领域的重要研究范式。
contribution: 论文提出 **“anchor-and-refine” 恒星反馈方案**：为每个星粒子锚定一个宿主网格单元，避免其被流动移走，从而保留热反馈储库。当冷却半径可分辨时，将全部超新星能量以热能注入宿主单元；当冷却半径不可分辨时，则细化宿主单元，并向周围气体单元沉积终端动量。理想化测试与高分辨率模拟结果一致，给出相符的超泡性质，并能保留热内部而不产生人为冷却。在孤立银河系质量星系模拟中，该方案捕捉到更精细的 X 射线辐射结构，以及边界清晰、X 射线明亮的中央中平面，并产生比纯混合反馈更平滑的恒星形成历史。热气体主导外流的质量装载，质量装载因子在高度 $z > 1\ \mathrm{kpc}$ 处约为 $\eta \approx 0.2$ 并趋于平台。相态分解表明，热气体维持稳定、能量驱动的风，而较冷外流因辐射冷却和引力回落而随高度减弱。这些结果强调 **热反馈在驱动星系风中的作用**；通过保留热超泡内部及热能与动能的分配，anchor-and-refine 改善了有限分辨率下对热气体、恒星形成和反馈的处理，为未来星系尺度与宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟应用提供支持。
summary: (abridged) Stellar feedback regulates galactic baryon cycles, but galaxy-scale simulations often cannot resolve supernova cooling radii. Momentum-based subgrid models can consequently underresolve the hot gas around young stars. We develop an "anchor-and-refine" feedback scheme that anchors a host cell near each star particle, preventing its displacement and preserving a thermal-feedback reservoir. When the cooling radius is resolved, all supernova energy is injected into the host cell as thermal energy; otherwise, the host cell is refined and terminal momentum is deposited into surrounding gas cells. Idealized tests agree with high-resolution simulations, yielding consistent superbubble properties and preserving hot interiors without artificial cooling. In an isolated Milky Way-mass galaxy, the scheme captures finer X-ray-emitting structures and a sharply defined, X-ray-bright central mid-plane. It also produces a smoother star formation history than pure hybrid feedback. Hot gas dominates outflow mass loading, with the mass-loading factor plateauing at approximately 0.2 at heights z>1 kpc. Phase decomposition indicates that hot gas sustains a steady, energy-driven wind, whereas cooler outflows decline with height because of radiative cooling and gravitational fallback. These results highlight the role of thermal feedback in driving galactic winds. By preserving hot superbubble interiors and the partition of thermal and kinetic energy, anchor-and-refine improves the treatment of hot gas, star formation, and feedback at limited resolution, supporting future applications to galaxy-scale and cosmological zoom-in simulations.

title: Feeding or Fleeing: The Impact of Enhanced Early Black Hole Growth on Circumgalactic Clumps at $z > 6$
background_knowledge: 在标准 ΛCDM 宇宙学框架下，暗物质晕通过等级成团过程增长，重子物质沿纤维状结构吸积进入晕内，并在星系周围形成多相、延展的环星系介质（circumgalactic medium，CGM）。CGM 连接宇宙网吸积、星系盘、恒星形成、星系风与黑洞反馈，是理解高红移大质量星系如何获得燃料、如何被反馈加热或抛射物质的关键界面。红移 $z > 6$ 对应宇宙黎明与再电离时期，第一批大质量星系及其中心超大质量黑洞可在较短时间内快速成长；黑洞吸积释放的辐射与机械能会显著改变 CGM 的热力学、金属丰度和运动学。CGM 中的致密团块可由纤维状气体流入、冷却凝聚、回收气体或反馈外流形成，其径向运动可表现为内流或外流，并可用金属丰度、气体密度和 HI 含量等示踪。超大质量黑洞在早期若经历温和超爱丁顿吸积，可能产生更强反馈和“吹出”（blow-out），从而将富金属、相对较冷的气体推向晕外。宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟通过在高分辨率下追踪单个大质量晕，可在统计不足但物理细节重要的高红移 regime 研究这些过程；子网格模型则决定黑洞吸积、反馈与星系风等未分辨物理。
contribution: 论文比较同一大质量暗物质晕在 $z > 6$ 的两个宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟：基准 Fable 模型与加入了温和超爱丁顿吸积所导致的早期黑洞加速增长的 Fable-SE 模型。作者在 CGM 中识别致密气体团块，并追踪其气体性质、恒星含量以及随宇宙时间的径向演化。在所达到的分辨率下，两个模拟给出的团块气体质量、气体尺度及关联恒星质量分布大体相似；差异主要体现在团块丰度、金属丰度和径向演化。**Fable-SE 产生显著更多富金属团块，并在 $z \lesssim 7$ 的强 AGN 驱动吹出阶段出现向外运动的团块族群**；这些团块与受扰动的 HI-rich 气体及相对较高的气体密度相关联，从而把 Fable-SE 中致密、富金属 CGM 结构增多与其更强的 AGN 吹出阶段联系起来。尽管总体以内向迁移为主，Fable-SE 在吹出阶段仍包含向外运动的团块，部分可越过维里半径。**因此，大质量高红移星系周围致密 CGM 团块的分布同时反映纤维状吸积与反馈驱动的 CGM 演化，而强烈的早期 AGN 活动与含相对较冷气体的致密、富金属气体结构向外迁移相关。**
summary: The circumgalactic medium (CGM) of massive high-redshift galaxies contains inflowing filamentary gas, recycled material, and feedback-driven outflows. We investigate the formation and evolution of dense CGM clumps in two cosmological zoom-in simulations of the same massive halo at $z > 6$: the fiducial Fable model and the modified Fable-SE model, which includes enhanced early black hole growth through mild super-Eddington accretion. We identify dense gas clumps in the CGM and follow their gas properties, stellar content, and radial evolution across cosmic time. At the resolution probed here, the two simulations show broadly similar distributions of clump gas mass, gas size and associated stellar mass. Instead, the clump populations differ mainly in their abundance, metallicity, and radial evolution. Fable-SE produces substantially more metal-enriched clumps, including an outward-moving population during the strong AGN-driven blow-out phase at $z \lesssim 7$. These systems are associated with disturbed HI-rich gas and relatively high gas densities, linking the increased prevalence of dense, metal-enriched CGM structures in Fable-SE to its stronger AGN-driven blow-out phase. Although inward migration dominates overall, Fable-SE also contains an outward-moving clump population during the blow-out phase, with some clumps moving beyond the virial radius. Our results therefore indicate that the distribution of dense CGM clumps around massive high-redshift galaxies reflects both filamentary accretion and feedback-driven CGM evolution, with strong early AGN activity associated with the outward migration of dense, metal-enriched gas structures containing relatively cool gas.

title: Channelled versus Isotropic Accretion of Galaxy Groups onto Clusters: Kinematics, Spin Alignment, and Assembly Bias
background_knowledge:
在 ΛCDM 宇宙学框架下，宇宙结构由暗物质密度扰动在引力作用下层级增长。物质首先形成暗物质晕，暗物质晕在更大尺度上沿宇宙网分布：星系团和星系群占据节点，纤维连接节点，纤维之间是墙与空洞。星系团并非封闭系统，而是通过持续吸积周围星系群与场星系而增长；这些入团物质可以沿与星系团直接相连的主纤维进入，也可来自支流纤维、主纤维外缘或较各向同性的场区。因而，吸积的拓扑路径可能把大尺度环境的信息写入星系群的运动学、角动量和轨道，而不仅是其质量。
\n研究这一问题的常用范式是把宇宙学数值模拟中的暗物质晕目录与纤维识别算法结合，统计星系群（或晕）相对宿主纤维的自旋轴方向、速度方向、入团速度与径向程度，并用 $R_{200}$ 等半径归一化位置。星系群自旋主要由潮汐力矩在结构形成过程中赋予，其与纤维的平行或垂直取向可反映非线性坍缩、角动量重分布和形成历史；在固定质量下，形成历史或环境仍影响晕属性，即 assembly bias。吸积通道还会影响轨道近心距和速度各向异性，进而影响星系团内介质激波、星系剥离和星系团成员的运动学。
\n由于这些效应通常较弱且依赖质量、距离和纤维密度，需要在较大体积的模拟中构造大统计样本，并用宽视场光谱巡天检验。论文正是在此背景下测量通道化与各向同性吸积的差异。
contribution: 论文基于 MDPL2 模拟的 $(1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Gpc})^3$ 体积，利用 DisPerSE 纤维识别，将 $212{,}704$ 个星系群—星系团入团对（覆盖 $27{,}029$ 个星系团）划分为 primary（与星系团直接相连的主纤维）、secondary（支流）、primary-outskirt 与 isotropic 四类吸积通道。核心结果如下：（i）两类通道化吸积中，星系群自旋轴在低于“自旋翻转”质量时主要平行于纤维，高于该质量时主要垂直；primary 与 secondary 的 $\log_{10} M_\mathrm{flip}\;[h^{-1}\,M_{\odot}]$ 分别为 $13.07$ 和 $13.12$，二者仅差 $0.05$ dex 且与零一致，并比场样本高 $1.3$–$1.4$ dex，而各向同性样本没有翻转；$M_\mathrm{flip}$ 在至 $7\,R_{200}$ 范围内保持径向平坦。（ii）在 primary 类中，$M_\mathrm{flip}$ 随宿主纤维的线质量密度升高，从细弱纤维的 $12.96$ 增至致密桥的 $13.44$；在匹配星系群质量、星系团质量与距离后，上升趋势仍为正，但幅度不确定（$0.07$–$0.58$ dex）。（iii）各向同性星系群在 $2\,R_{200}$ 处低于随机取向（与纤维夹角 $60^\circ$ 内的比例为 $41\%$，相对随机预期为 $4.3\sigma$ 亏缺）；primary 星系群在 $2\,R_{200}$ 处有 $85\%$ 的速度—纤维对齐比例，而各向同性星系群的入团速度更快 $150$–$180\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$，且在至 $5\,R_{200}$ 范围内更偏径向。由此，在匹配距离时，各向同性星系群预计可达到的轨道近心距比 primary 星系群最多小 $10\%$；primary 样本混合后的近心距更小只反映其离星系团更近。**吸积的拓扑路径以及宿主纤维的线密度共同塑造星系群进入星系团的方式**，并可由宽视场光谱巡天检验。
summary: Galaxy clusters grow by accreting groups from the cosmic web, but whether the route of infall (along a cluster-connected filament or from the open field) imprints a group's kinematics, spin, and orbit remains unmeasured at scale. We classify $212{,}704$ group-cluster infall pairs across $27{,}029$ clusters in the $(1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Gpc})^3$ MDPL2 simulation into primary (cluster-connected), secondary (tributary), primary-outskirt, and isotropic channels using DisPerSE filaments. (i) In both channelled classes, group spin axes lie mainly parallel to the filament below a `spin-flip' mass and perpendicular above it, $\log_{10} M_\mathrm{flip}\;[h^{-1}\,M_{\odot}] = 13.07$ and $13.12$, a $0.05$-dex offset consistent with zero, lying $1.3-1.4$ dex above the field, while isotropic groups show no flip; $M_\mathrm{flip}$ stays radially flat out to $7\,R_{200}$. (ii) Within the primary class $M_\mathrm{flip}$ rises with the linear mass density of the host filament, from $12.96$ (thin tendrils) to $13.44$ (dense bridges); matching group mass, cluster mass and distance keeps the rise positive but leaves its size uncertain ($0.07-0.58$ dex). (iii) Isotropic groups fall below random alignment at $2\,R_{200}$ ($41$ per cent within $60^\circ$, a $4.3σ$ deficit). Primary groups show $85$ per cent velocity-filament alignment at $2\,R_{200}$, and isotropic groups infall $150-180\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ faster, and more radially, out to $5\,R_{200}$. At matched distance isotropic groups are therefore predicted to reach orbital pericentres up to $10$ per cent smaller than primary groups, whose smaller pooled pericentres reflect only their proximity to the cluster. The topological route of accretion, and within it the host filament's linear density, shapes how groups enter clusters, testable with wide-area spectroscopic surveys.

title: A MUSE and MeerKAT study of dynamics and star formation in HCG 16
background_knowledge: 星系并非孤立演化，其恒星形成历史、气体含量与动力学状态会受到所处环境及星系间相互作用的显著影响。紧凑星系群（HCGs）是若干星系在较小范围内高度聚集的系统，常被视为研究星系并合、潮汐扰动、气体剥离与恒星形成触发机制的理想实验室。其典型观测特征包括形态扭曲、潮汐尾、延展的中性氢（H I）结构以及增强的恒星形成活动。研究范式通常结合多波段观测：积分场光谱（如 MUSE）用于获取 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 等发射线分布、电离气体运动学与恒星族性质；射电干涉阵列（如 MeerKAT）用于高分辨率成像中性氢；再通过恒星族合成与空间分辨的恒星形成历史，重建星系内部与外部区域的不同演化阶段。
contribution: 论文利用经 pyPipe3D 处理的 MUSE 数据提取 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 图像与恒星族合成结果，并处理 MeerKAT 数据得到高分辨率中性氢数据立方，在二维和三维层面分析 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 与 H I 的结构和动力学，同时生成空间分辨的恒星形成历史以比较星系内外区域。研究发现 HCG 16 中一次主要恒星形成事件始于约 400–500 Myr 前，与 NGC 848 从其他成员星系附近经过的时间相符，并在部分星系中至少持续到 50–60 Myr 前。H I 分布在群内受到强烈扰动，但 **HCG 16a 仍保留近规则的盘结构**，而 **HCG 16b 具有与之相关的 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 尾**。作者认为 **NGC 848 的经过可能触发了 HCG 16 的恒星形成，但本身不足以解释 HCG 16c 和 16d 当前的星暴活动**；**该群的演化更适合用成员星系之间的多次相互作用来解释，而非一次单一强遭遇**。
summary:
Context. Hickson Compact Groups (HCGs) present an ideal environment for studying galaxy interactions. HCG 16 is a group of five galaxies in an intermediate stage of evolution (Phase 2), with several members displaying signs of interaction, including distorted morphologies, tidal features, and enhanced star formation rates.
  Aims. We aim to better understand the evolution of HCG 16 and its member galaxies, focusing on the relationship between neutral hydrogen and star formation, while reconstructing the interaction history of the group.
  Methods. We analysed MUSE data processed with pyPipe3D to extract H$α$ images and stellar population synthesis results, and reduced MeerKAT data to produce a high-resolution HI cube. We examined the structure and dynamics of the H$α$ and HI lines in both 2D and 3D, and produced spatially resolved star formation histories to compare the inner and outer parts of the galaxies.
  Results. We identify a major star formation episode in HCG 16 beginning ~400-500 Myr ago, coinciding with the passage of NGC 848 close to the other member galaxies, and that continued at least until 50-60 Myr ago in some galaxies. The HI distribution is highly perturbed in the group, although HCG 16a retains a nearly regular disk, while HCG 16b has associated H$α$ tails.
  Conclusions. The passage of NGC 848 probably activated star formation in HCG 16, but cannot by itself explain the current starburst activity in HCG 16c and 16d. The evolution of the group is better explained by multiple interactions among its members than by a single strong encounter.

title: Sequince: a modular sequential Monte Carlo toolkit
background_knowledge: 在天文学与宇宙学中，贝叶斯推断常需计算后验分布 $p(\theta \mid d)$ 与证据 $Z = \int \mathcal{L}(\theta)\,\pi(\theta)\,d\theta$。高维、多峰或强退化的参数空间会使传统 MCMC 难以充分混合。序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）用带权样本群 $\{(\theta_i, w_i)\}_{i=1}^{N}$ 逼近一串概率分布，通过加权、重采样与 MCMC 变异等步骤，从先验逐步过渡到后验，也可用于粒子滤波和模型比较。嵌套采样是计算证据的常用方法，也可视为 SMC 的一种变体。模块化、可组合且支持 CPU/GPU 的 SMC 软件基础设施，有助于方法学研究与大尺度天文推断的可复现分析。
contribution: 本文提出并介绍 sequince v0.1.0，一个用于构建 SMC 算法的模块化 Python 工具包。它将加权、重采样、变异、变换与控制操作拆分为可复用、可扩展的组件，并可组合实现不同算法；内置 tempered SMC、persistent sampling 以及基于 SMC 的嵌套采样等预置采样器。其核心组件遵循 Python Array API 标准，兼容 NumPy、JAX、PyTorch 与 CuPy，从而支持在 CPU 或 GPU 上进行分析；同时提供随机数控制与检查点机制以支持可复现的科学工作流。**该工作的核心贡献是提供可复用、可扩展的 SMC 基础设施，降低方法学研究与应用门槛，并支持跨数组后端与可复现计算。**
summary: Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods approximate sequences of probability distributions using populations of weighted samples and are widely applicable, including in Bayesian inference and particle filtering. We present sequince, a modular Python toolkit for constructing SMC algorithms from reusable and extensible components. The toolkit provides modular steps for weighting, resampling, mutation, transformation, and control operations that are composed to implement different algorithms. It also includes prebuilt samplers for tempered SMC, persistent sampling and nested sampling via SMC. Its core components follow the Python Array API standard, supporting NumPy, JAX, PyTorch, and CuPy, enabling analyses on CPUs or GPUs. Random-number control and checkpointing support reproducible scientific workflows. This paper describes sequince v0.1.0 and its design as reusable infrastructure for methodological research and application of SMC methods.

title: Detailed chemo-dynamical characterization of four elusive Milky Way star clusters
background_knowledge: 银河系的结构与恒星族是理解星系形成与演化的重要化石记录。在等级结构形成框架下，银河系由早期原位形成的星系盘、核球，以及长期吸积并并合的小质量星系和恒星流共同组装而成。银晕中一些暗淡、稀疏的恒星系统可能是吸积残留、星团或特殊子结构，但仅凭空间分布往往难以判定其来源。化学-动力学分析通过测量视向速度、化学丰度（如 $[\mathrm{Fe/H}]$ 与 $\alpha$ 元素丰度）并结合天体测量给出的自行和轨道参数，重建这些系统的运动轨迹与化学演化历史。一般而言，$\alpha$ 元素主要由大质量恒星的核心坍缩超新星快速产生，而铁元素还会受到 Ia 型超新星延迟贡献，因此 $[\alpha/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 可反映恒星形成时标和星际介质富集历史；轨道能量 $E$、垂直角动量 $L_Z$、偏心率与最大银道面高度 $z_{\max}$ 则可用于区分原位形成与吸积来源。对极其暗弱、观测困难的系统，获得高信噪比光谱和精确运动学参数是限制其性质的关键。
contribution: 本文基于 VLT/X-shooter 中分辨率光谱，对 BH 140、Garro 01、BLISS 1 和 Kim 3 四个难以观测的恒星系统开展化学-动力学刻画，测量了精确的视向速度与化学丰度，并首次给出 BH 140 的金属丰度与 $\alpha$ 元素光谱表征、BLISS 1 与 Garro 01 的首次综合化学表征，以及 Kim 3 的首次光谱金属丰度。**BH 140、Garro 01 与 BLISS 1 是相对富金属系统，$[\mathrm{Fe/H}] \sim -0.7$ dex，并具有增强的 $\alpha$ 元素丰度；Kim 3 则明显贫金属，$[\mathrm{Fe/H}] \sim -1.8$ dex。** 轨道分析表明，Garro 01 与 BH 140 的轨道局限于距银道面 $< 1.5$ kpc 内，其中 Garro 01 还具有高度圆化的轨道，二者很可能起源于原位；不过 BH 140 的高轨道偏心率和轻微 $\alpha$ 元素不足仍保留其他可能。BLISS 1 无疑是吸积系统，但未表现出与任何已知前身天体的清晰动力学关联，其轨道处于高能量 $E$、高垂直角动量 $L_Z$ 的顺行区域，$z_{\max} \sim 8$ kpc；其化学性质似乎更支持原位起源，并可能与 Aleph 子结构有关。最后，Kim 3 的高能量、低 $L_Z$ 轨道被暂 tentatively 关联到 Elqui 流。
summary: A variety of faint and observationally challenging stellar systems has been discovered in the Milky Way in the last decades. Unveiling their kinematic and chemical properties is crucial to understand their nature and to assess their role in the history of our Galaxy. In this paper, we present a chemo-dynamical analysis of four elusive stellar systems (BH 140, Garro 01, BLISS 1, and Kim 3) using spectra collected with the X-shooter medium-resolution spectrograph at the VLT. We derived precise line-of-sight velocities and chemical abundances for all targets. Specifically, we provide the first spectroscopic characterization of metallicity and α-element content for BH 140, the first comprehensive chemical characterization for BLISS 1 and Garro 01, and the first spectroscopic metallicity determination for Kim 3. BH 140, Garro 01 and BLISS 1 are relatively metal-rich systems with [Fe/H] ~ -0.7 dex and have enhanced α-element abundances, whereas Kim 3 is notably metal-poor with [Fe/H] ~ -1.8 dex. We also performed an orbital analysis to investigate their origin as accreted or in situ systems. We found that Garro 01 and BH 140 have orbits confined within < 1.5 kpc from the Galactic plane, the former having also a remarkably circular orbit. They were likely born in situ, although the high orbital eccentricity of BH 140 and its mild deficiency in α-elements leave other possibilities open. Although undoubtedly accreted, BLISS 1 does not exhibit a clear dynamical association with any known progenitor, lying in a high energy (E) - high vertical angular momentum (LZ ) prograde orbit reaching a maximum height from the Galactic plane of zmax ~ 8 kpc. Its chemical properties seem to favor an in situ origin, which might be connected with the Aleph sub-structure. Finally, we tentatively link the high energy and low LZ orbit of Kim 3 to the Elqui stream.

title: Odds Estimation for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Local Core Galaxies
background_knowledge: 在等级结构形成框架下，大质量星系通过并合成长，其中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）也会成对形成束缚的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）。双星轨道先因动力学摩擦下沉，随后在富星环境中通过恒星散射硬化，最终由引力波辐射主导并并合。双星在核区扫除恒星可留下浅核和恒星质量亏损，使核星系的结构成为双星演化的间接化石记录。近邻宇宙中直接辨认 SMBHB 很难，因为空间分辨率有限、双星可能处于不活跃状态，且单黑洞与双星信号常难区分；因此常用星系并合历史、核结构、中心密度与速度弥散等观测量构造统计先验，并结合脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）等引力波探测手段筛选候选。该领域的研究范式通常是把宇宙学模拟、半解析双星演化模型与观测星系种群结合，建立可检验的概率预测和候选名单。
contribution: 论文将 IllustrisTNG 提供的大质量星系组装历史与半解析核区扫除模型结合，把 $z=0$ 时可观测的核星系性质映射为宿主束缚 SMBHB 的概率。作者首先用观测启发的星系恒星质量函数构造核星系种群，再让双星经历动力学摩擦、恒星硬化与引力波辐射演化，并以恒星质量亏损、恒星质量、中心密度、中心速度弥散和有效半径五个观测量作逻辑回归分类。**该模型在模拟系统上表现良好**：pseudo-$R^2$ 为 $0.51\pm0.03$，准确率为 $0.95\pm0.01$，精确率为 $0.92\pm0.03$，召回率为 $0.82\pm0.04$。模拟中未并合双星通常很致密，轨道分离在约 $0.3$ pc 处达到峰值，但**仅约 0.3% 会进入 PTA 频段辐射**。将模型应用于观测核星系后，作者给出 **8 个近邻星系以超过一半概率宿主 SMBHB 的候选**；其中 **Messier 86（NGC 4406）尤为可能**，且此前已被独立方法类似识别，因而**值得后续观测检验**。
summary: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are expected products of massive galaxy mergers, but identifying binaries in nearby galaxies remains challenging. We combine simulated massive-galaxy assembly histories from IllustrisTNG with a semi-analytic core-scouring model to connect observable core galaxy properties to the probability of hosting a bound SMBHB at z=0. We (i) construct a core galaxy population using an observationally motivated galaxy stellar mass function, (ii) model binary evolution through dynamical friction, stellar hardening, and gravitational-wave emission, and (iii) perform logistic regressions with five observable predictors: stellar mass deficit, stellar mass, central density, central velocity dispersion, and effective radius. The resulting models perform well on simulated systems, achieving a pseudo-$R^2$ of $0.51\pm0.03$, accuracy $0.95\pm0.01$, precision $0.92\pm0.03$, and recall $0.82\pm0.04$. Uncoalesced binaries are typically compact, with separations peaking near 0.3 pc, though only $\sim0.3\%$ emit in the pulsar timing array band. Applying the model to observed core galaxies, we identify eight nearby galaxies more likely than not to host SMBHBs. Of those eight host candidates, we note Messier 86 (NGC 4406) as a particularly likely example that was similarly identified using independent means and therefore warrants future follow-up.

title: Core-collapse universality for inelastic self-interacting dark matter halos
background_knowledge: 暗物质自相互作用（self-interacting dark matter，SIDM）模型在冷暗物质（cold dark matter，CDM）的引力成团图像上，引入暗物质粒子之间的非引力碰撞。碰撞在暗物质晕内部输运能量和动量，其效果相当于热传导：内区被热化后形成较平的等温核心；随后热量向外传递，核心可先膨胀，再发生 gravothermal collapse（引力热坍缩），中心密度在有限时间内急剧升高。该过程对小尺度结构、暗物质晕密度剖面、卫星星系动力学和强透镜等观测有重要影响。研究通常采用 gravothermal fluid 近似，把暗物质晕视为具有由散射截面决定的热导率的自引力流体，数值求解密度与速度弥散随半径和时间的演化；弹性散射与速度依赖截面会改变热导率，而非弹性散射可通过激发态与退激过程额外带走能量，从而改变冷却与坍缩时标。该子领域的核心问题是：在不同微观相互作用模型下，暗物质晕的演化是否具有普适标度律，以及能否用半解析方法预测坍缩时间并与观测比较。
contribution: 本文在 gravothermal fluid 框架下研究具有速度依赖弹性散射和非弹性耗散自相互作用的暗物质晕的引力热坍缩。作者推导了暗物质被上散射到激发态、再退激回基态并释放粒子带走晕能量的有效冷却率，并数值求解球对称暗物质晕的 gravothermal fluid 方程，覆盖核心增长与坍缩两个演化阶段。结果表明：**仅含弹性自相互作用的暗物质晕具有普适的演化轨迹；非弹性暗物质晕的演化则显著更多样**。尽管如此，**非弹性暗物质晕动力学仍包含隐藏的参数普适性**，据此作者给出了一个半解析公式，可在不运行模拟的情况下计算任意速度依赖的弹性与非弹性截面下的暗物质晕坍缩时间。
summary: We study the gravothermal collapse of inelastic dark matter halos with velocity-dependent elastic and dissipative self-interactions. Within the gravothermal fluid framework, we derive the effective cooling rate for dark matter upscattering to an excited state followed by decay back to the ground state, with emitted states carrying off energy from the halo.
